description.en: One curated market index built from six installable-plugin leaderboards (total stars, weekly star gain, npm downloads all-time and weekly, recent commits, newest arrivals). A plugin charting on several boards is filed once under the highest-priority board; lower-board slots are refilled by the next ranked plugin, and top-rank-* labels list every board it appears on. Selection numbers are exact sortKeys; a missing number omits the key instead of writing 0. Third-party content — review before installing.
description.zh: 把六张可安装插件榜（Star 总榜、Star 周榜、npm 累计 / 周下载、活跃榜、新上架榜）合并成一份文档。同一插件上多张榜时不丢条目：只录入一次（归榜优先级最高的那张），其在后续榜上的名额由该榜后续名次顶替，top-rank-* 标签记录它上过的每一张榜。选型数字是 sortKeys 的精确值，缺数据就不写这个键，绝不写 0。第三方内容，安装前请自行确认。

description.en: A Claude Code desktop theme that restyles the DeepSeek Harness web GUI with Claude-inspired colors and dark mode.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 打造的 Claude Code 桌面主题，提供 Claude 风格配色与深色模式。

description.en: A plugin marketplace for discovering, reviewing, and installing DeepSeek Harness plugins from across the internet.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件市场，每日更新，从全网收集并审核后发布。

description.en: Local-first AI agent runtime and MCP bridge with sandboxed sessions, memory, credentials, and audit/replay.
description.zh: 本地优先的自托管 AI 代理运行时与 MCP 桥接，提供沙箱会话、记忆、凭据和审计/回放。

description.en: Use ChatGPT, Claude, and Grok subscriptions as LLM providers for DeepSeek Harness via OAuth login, no API keys.
description.zh: 把 ChatGPT、Claude 和 Grok 订阅通过 OAuth 登录接入 DeepSeek Harness 作为 LLM 提供方，无需 API 密钥

description.en: Desktop-native BigFish companion showing DeepSeek Harness agent status, always on top on Windows.
description.zh: Windows 上置顶显示的桌面原生 BigFish 伴侣，展示 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 实时状态。

description.en: A pentest mode for DeepSeek Harness that records targets, clues, results, assets, and vulnerabilities with web views.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供渗透测试模式，记录目标、线索、结果、资产与漏洞，并支持网页视图查看。

description.en: Connects QQ bot to DeepSeek Harness as a frontend protocol driver for the dsh agent.
description.zh: 让 QQ 机器人接入 DeepSeek Harness，作为 dsh 智能体的前端协议驱动

description.en: An npm installable DeepSeek Harness Web plugin for managing local skills safely.
description.zh: 可通过 npm 安装的 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，用于安全管理本地 skills

description.en: Meme plugin for DeepSeek Harness to find, send, and learn memes for QQ bot.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 QQ 机器人表情包插件，支持搜索、发送并学习记忆表情包。

description.en: Pools free model quotas across WorkBuddy accounts and 76 providers with failover, routing, a usage dashboard and a local OpenAI gateway.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 多账号与 76 家免费模型额度聚合到同一池，支持容错、路由、用量看板和本地 OpenAI 网关。

description.en: Compatibility-adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness local runtime plus prompt management, targeting dsh 0.2.2-rc.5 on Web and desktop.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地运行时兼容适配与提示词管理插件，适配 dsh 0.2.2-rc.5，支持官方 Web 与桌面端。

description.en: Turns a video into a single packed storyboard image: 9-16 numbered cells with timestamps, transcript and an audio envelope.
description.zh: 将视频打包成一张分镜图：9-16 个带时间戳的编号格子，附转写文本与音频包络。

description.en: Adds Codex-style @file mentions to DeepSeek Harness, letting users search workspace files and attach paths to prompts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 @file 提及，可在输入框搜索工作区文件并将路径附加到提示。

description.en: Retrieves 1000+ evidence-graded fix lessons from previously solved failures via a single MCP call to speed up debugging.
description.zh: 通过一次 MCP 调用检索 1000+ 条经证据分级的已解决故障修复经验，加速调试。

description.en: DSH plugin integrating ego-lite Chromium browser for AI agents with 13 structured ego_* tools for snapshot, click, form fill, screenshot, CDP control, and task isolation.
description.zh: DSH（DeepSeek Harness）插件：把 ego-lite 浏览器（给 AI Agent 用的 Chromium）接入 HARNESS——13 个结构化 ego_* 工具（文本语义快照、语义定位点击、表单填充、截图、CDP 控制、任务空间隔离），内置 ego 运行时，Linux + Chrome 开箱即用，无需克隆官方仓库或手动构建。

description.en: InvoiceFlowAI downloads email invoices, performs OCR, classifies and archives them, and generates Excel expense summaries.
description.zh: 自动下载邮箱电子发票，OCR 识别、分类归档并生成 Excel 报销汇总，支持 Windows 与 macOS。

description.en: A built-in plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness to search, download, and install 4000+ curated community plugins.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 内置插件市场，可在设置→插件中心搜索、下载并安装 4000+ 人工精选社区插件，每日更新且免费。

description.en: Gives DSH sessions a fading long-term memory: it selects what to keep, decays stale entries, and recalls with timestamps.
description.zh: 为 DSH 会话提供会淡忘的长期记忆：自动挑重点保存、按时间衰减，并在需要时带时间地回想起来。

description.en: A curated DSH plugin directory that verifies real plugins, filters fakes, and offers scene-based categories, recommendations and popularity rankings.
description.zh: 精选 DSH 插件目录：核实真插件、剔除蹭标签项目，提供场景分类、推荐与热度排行，帮助 30 秒找到合适插件。

description.en: Use ChatGPT/Codex subscriptions inside DeepSeek Harness with native routing and quota visibility.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅，提供原生路由与配额查看。

description.en: Open-source agentic AI sandbox matrix for secure, isolated agent execution on Kubernetes at scale.
description.zh: 开源智能体 AI 沙箱矩阵，在 Kubernetes 上大规模隔离、安全地运行 AI 智能体。

description.en: Structural memory for AI coding agents using bi-temporal graphs, MCP-native, zero LLM calls.
description.zh: 面向 AI 编程代理的结构化记忆，采用双时间图并原生支持 MCP，无需调用大模型，可接入 Cursor、Claude Code、Codex 等编辑器与工具。

description.en: Security guard for AI agents that blocks malicious skills, prevents data leaks and protects secrets via runtime action evaluation.
description.zh: 面向 AI 智能体的安全防护插件，通过运行时行为评估拦截恶意技能、防止数据泄露并保护密钥。

description.en: Unofficial DeepSeek Harness LLM provider plugin for Command Code, adding live model catalog and reasoning-effort support.
description.zh: 非官方 DeepSeek Harness 的 Command Code 模型接入插件，提供实时模型目录、推理强度支持与模型页卡片。

description.en: Boots, builds and drives an iOS Simulator or USB iPhone from the conversation with 22 agent tools for tapping UI by accessibility ID, OCR or list rows.
description.zh: 在对话中启动、构建并操控 iOS 模拟器或 USB 连接的 iPhone，提供 22 个智能体工具，可按无障碍标识、OCR 文本或列表行定位并点击界面。

description.en: An Excel and data-analysis skill that profiles dirty spreadsheets, cleans them, aligns on requirements, analyzes, reconciles and delivers verified numbers.
description.zh: 一个 Excel 数据分析全流程技能：体检脏表、清洗、对齐需求、分析、对账并交付可经得起追问的数字。

description.en: NSFW content-creation plugin for DSH that uses self-hosted models to generate adult images, narrated videos and multi-shot short films with LoRA and agent storyboarding.
description.zh: 为 DSH 打造的 NSFW 内容创作插件，用自托管模型生成成人图像、有声视频与多镜头短片，支持 LoRA 与 Agent 分镜。

description.en: Compare 2-4 answers, files or live pages side by side in the DSH chat, with shared context, saved rationale and adoption review.
description.zh: 在 DSH 主对话中并排比较 2–4 版回答、文件或实时网页，同步上下文并保留选择理由与采纳审查。

description.en: Bridges WeChat to DSH so you can chat from your phone and have your desktop DSH agent do the work, with no public IP required.
description.zh: 将微信接入 DSH，用手机聊天即可让电脑上的 DSH 代理完成任务，无需公网 IP。

description.en: A desktop pet plugin for DSH Web GUI, a floating companion you can drag, feed, and play with.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 桌面宠物插件，以 QQ 宠物形态在右下角悬浮，可拖拽、投喂和玩耍，通过 config.yaml 以官方 .dsh-plugin 格式安装。

description.en: MCP bridge that exposes the local craft-anything CLI as mcp__craft__* tools, with a composer mode switch, status page, CLI runner and verified installer.
description.zh: 把本地 craft-anything CLI 以 mcp__craft__* 工具形式接入 DSH 的 MCP 桥接插件，带输入框模式切换、状态页、CLI 运行器和校验安装器。

description.en: Provides free OpenCode Zen LLM models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) without requiring an API key.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 提供免费 OpenCode Zen LLM 模型，无需 API key。

description.en: Cross-session memory plugin with seven-layer SQLite store, BM25 retrieval, and per-window dream consolidation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆，使用七层 SQLite 存储（soul/user/project/fact/lesson/topic/rules），支持 BM25 检索与按窗口的梦境式记忆整合。

description.en: DSH skin replacing reasoning level with a slider, mapping 0-30 strength to UI colors.
description.zh: 将推理等级改为滑块，把0到30的强度映射为不同界面颜色。

description.en: Game-like mission system for Matt Pocock skills, using a fog map and task bar.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中的 Matt Pocock 技能提供游戏化任务系统，用迷雾地图展示进度，并由任务栏逐步推进。

description.en: Ocean-themed WebGPU skin for DeepSeek Harness and Chrome/Edge with new-tab extension.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 和 Chrome/Edge 提供海洋主题 WebGPU 皮肤，并附带新标签页扩展。

description.en: MarkText's muya WYSIWYG Markdown editor embedded in the DeepSeek Harness right sidebar for editing Markdown as it will look.
description.zh: 将 MarkText 的 muya 所见即所得 Markdown 编辑器嵌入 DeepSeek Harness 右侧栏，边写边看最终效果。

description.en: Manages archived sessions in DeepSeek Harness, safely organizing and retrieving historical session data.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理归档会话，安全整理和检索历史会话数据。

description.en: Provides expert guidance for HarmonyOS NEXT development including IDE operations, performance tuning, architecture, and automation testing.
description.zh: 为 HarmonyOS NEXT（API 12+）开发提供指导，涵盖 IDE 操作、性能调优、HAP/HAR/HSP 架构与自动化测试。

description.en: Backup, export, import, and migrate DeepSeek Harness configurations with one-click restore via Web UI and host engine.
description.zh: 备份、导出、导入和迁移 DeepSeek Harness 配置，通过宿主引擎和 Web UI 实现一键还原。

description.en: Build, run, and interact with Android emulator or USB device via adb inside a conversation.
description.zh: 通过 adb 在对话中构建、运行并操作 Android 模拟器或 USB 设备。

description.en: Reverse engineering and authorized pentesting skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, with 85 SKILL.md security research skills.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供逆向工程与授权渗透测试技能包，包含 85 个 SKILL.md 安全研究技能。

description.en: Android companion app for DeepSeek Harness providing chat, goals, approvals, and notifications over LAN.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Android 配套应用，通过局域网在手机上聊天、查看目标、审批请求和接收通知，使用 Kotlin 与 Jetpack Compose 开发。

description.en: Adds OpenCode Go subscription models to DeepSeek Harness with streaming replies, tool calls, image input and a web settings page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中接入 OpenCode Go 订阅模型，支持流式回复、工具调用、图片输入和 Web 设置页。

description.en: Generates interactive HTML UI cards directly in DSH conversations with streaming preview, animations, and theme following.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中直接生成交互式 HTML 卡片，支持流式预览与主题跟随

description.en: SSH remote workspaces for DeepSeek Harness: browse and edit remote files, run terminals, review Git diffs and build/test across multiple hosts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 SSH 远程工作区：远程文件浏览编辑、终端、Git 差异查看与跨主机构建测试。

description.en: A skin market plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 100+ skins, ratings, community submissions, and local management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness皮肤市场插件，收录100多款皮肤，支持评分和社区投稿，并可管理本地皮肤。

description.en: Compresses finished conversation turns in place while keeping the prefix cache, cutting context usage live.
description.zh: 在会话中原位压缩已完成的对话轮次，并保留前缀缓存，实时降低上下文占用。

description.en: SQLite-backed local taskboard with projects, agent task claiming and review, plus a native Web UI.
description.zh: 基于 SQLite 的本地任务看板，支持项目、代理领取与审核任务，并配有原生 Web 界面。

description.en: Import conversation histories from external AI agents (Claude Code, Codex) into DSH as resumable sessions, with export/sync back.
description.zh: 把Claude Code、Codex、Reasonix等Agent工具的历史消息导入DSH并继续对话，支持导出与同步。

description.en: Interactive terminal UI plugin for DeepSeek Harness coding, using the Tianshu Tui rendering core.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编程提供交互式终端界面，基于 Tianshu Tui 渲染核心。

description.en: Native DSH QQ bot plugin that uses NapCat's OneBot v11 to receive and send messages, images, generated art and stickers via a micro-kernel with 13 sub-plugins.
description.zh: DSH 原生 QQ 机器人插件，经 NapCat OneBot v11 收发消息，支持发图、生图、表情包，微内核加 13 个子插件。

description.en: Bloom is a DSH theme plugin offering Morandi-style OKLCH palettes with light/dark modes and WCAG AA accessibility.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Bloom 莫兰迪配色主题插件，含 4 个变体、OKLCH 调色、明暗双模式，顶栏可一键切换，配色均达 WCAG AA 标准。

description.en: Injects jailbreak prompts at the request boundary so DeepSeek Harness models stop opening with refusals; zero host patches, toggleable, 17/20 baseline.
description.zh: 在请求边界注入破甲提示词，让 DeepSeek Harness 模型不再开口就拒绝；零宿主补丁，带阀门，可复核基线 17/20。

description.en: Adds a one-click button beside the DSH composer that rewrites your prompt draft in place without sending it.
description.zh: 在 DSH 输入框旁添加一键按钮，就地改写提示词草稿，且不会发送消息。

description.en: A soft-workflow DSH plugin: design a flow on a canvas, compile it into a plan prompt, and let the model execute and track state itself — no execution engine.
description.zh: 软工作流 DSH 插件：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型自行执行并记录运行状态，无需执行引擎。

description.en: In-place conversation rewind in the same session with optional file restore, mimicking Claude Code /rewind.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，可在同一会话窗口中就地回退对话到之前节点，并可选择同时恢复文件。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek token usage and balance with game-style damage animations and cost breakdowns.
description.zh: 监控 DeepSeek token 余额与用量，以游戏风格伤害动画展示并拆分费用明细。

description.en: Creates pixel-perfect clones of any webpage into a Vite + React project from a URL.
description.zh: 粘贴网址即可生成与原网页像素级一致的 Vite + React 复刻项目。

description.en: Creates persistent multi-model agent squads with reusable teams and per-agent policies for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 创建可复用的持久多模型智能体小队，支持为每个智能体配置模型与工具策略，并在普通聊天中协作。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style slider for choosing the model and reasoning effort, with a chibi mascot running animation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 Codex 风格的模型与推理强度滑块，并配有 Q 版大模型娘跑步动画。

description.en: Codex-style draggable reasoning-effort slider for DeepSeek Harness with per-level gradient colors, purple stardust effects and recolored value text.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 Codex 风格推理等级滑条，档位渐变配色，高档位带紫色星尘粒子特效。

description.en: MCP server that lets AI agents safely invoke Stata on a local device for data analysis.
description.zh: 一个 MCP 服务器，让 AI 代理在本地设备上安全调用 Stata 进行数据分析。

description.en: Accumulates Bilibili-sourced reflections into a local human-world.md to shape DSH's persona, with history, favorites, likes and coins off by default.
description.zh: 把来自 B 站的信笺反思默认积累到本地 human-world.md，用于塑造 DSH 的人格；历史、收藏、点赞与投币默认关闭。

description.en: An AI-run QQ group bot handling approval, file broadcasts, stickers, persona rotation, and card-based games while forwarding cards to QQ.
description.zh: AI 统管 QQ 群组：审核放行、群发文件、表情包入库、多人格陪聊，并把提问卡片转发到 QQ。

description.en: DSH Agency Agents provides 271 summonable specialist agents for DeepSeek Harness across all industries.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供覆盖全行业的 271 个可召唤专业智能体

description.en: Gives your AI companion a self-judged, visible mood that shifts each turn, shown in a corner widget with value, emotion and timeline.
description.zh: 给 AI 伙伴一个会自己判断、看得见的心情：每轮聊完自动判断涨跌，右下角挂饰显示数值、情绪和时间线。

description.en: Structured decision-engine plugin for Agent Harnesses, natively supporting DeepSeek Harness and enabling OpenCode and Codex Harness.
description.zh: 面向 Agent Harness 的结构化决策引擎插件，原生支持 DeepSeek Harness，并支持 OpenCode 与 Codex Harness。

description.en: Oil UI's native DSH plugin that brings its UI design workflow into DeepSeek Harness: compare 3 design directions, then code, screenshot and iterate.
description.zh: Oil UI 的 DSH 原生插件，把界面设计流程接入 DeepSeek Harness：先并排对比 3 个设计方向，再写代码、截真图逐轮打磨。

description.en: Connects locally signed-in Trae models to DeepSeek Harness and shows a read-only credits overview.
description.zh: 将本地登录的Trae模型连接到DeepSeek Harness，并显示只读积分概览。

description.en: Extend local DeepSeek Harness to mobile, tablets, public internet, and IM apps via QR codes and web.
description.zh: 通过扫码或网页把本地 DeepSeek Harness 延伸到手机、平板和公网，远程调用本地 AI 助手

description.en: A DSH plugin preset editor for managing AI system prompts, including jailbreak presets, with import/export support.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供预设编辑器，可管理 AI 系统提示词和破限预设，支持导入导出。

description.en: A DSH plugin plus browser extension that sends finished conversation turns to the DeepSeek web page so its read-aloud feature speaks them on your own computer.
description.zh: 由 DSH 插件和浏览器扩展组成，把说完的会话内容自动交给 DeepSeek 网页端，用其朗读功能在你自己的电脑上出声。

description.en: Preview, edit, and generate Office documents such as DOCX inside DeepSeek Harness via the Fylar Office SDK.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过 Fylar Office SDK 预览、编辑并生成 DOCX 等 Office 文档。

description.en: OpenPencil design preview and editing plugin for DSH, allowing inspection and editing of .op documents in conversation.
description.zh: DSH 的 OpenPencil 设计预览与编辑插件，可在对话中查看和编辑 .op 文档。

description.en: A lightweight unified memory workspace that lets agents and your terminal share one searchable context instead of a bulky knowledge system.
description.zh: 一个轻量统一的记忆工作空间，让智能体与终端共享同一份可检索的上下文，而无需笨重的知识系统。

description.en: Prompt editor for DSH that spots gaps in your input, inserts a line chosen from 90 method cards, compares drafts and recovers original quotes.
description.zh: DSH 提示词编辑器：在输入框中发现遗漏，从90张方法卡中选句补入，可对照原稿改写、核对引文并恢复原话。

description.en: AI auto-review subagent for DeepSeek Harness approval requests, returning structured allow/deny verdicts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 审批请求提供第二模型自动审查，只读审查子代理返回含理由的允许或拒绝判定，默认失败即拒绝，全过程可从会话日志审计。

description.en: Open-source desktop SSH client with an AI assistant and end-to-end encrypted sync via your own Cloudflare account.
description.zh: 开源桌面 SSH 客户端，内置 AI 助手，并通过你自己的 Cloudflare 账户实现端到端加密同步。

description.en: Swaps DSH's default loading card for a 550C boot splash animation and retints native desktop title-bar buttons to terminal colors.
description.zh: 用 550C 开机动画替换 DSH 默认 Loading 卡片，并把桌面原生标题栏按钮改为终端配色。

description.en: Native roleplay agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness with active worldbooks, dynamic memory, character agents and immersive reading.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生角色扮演代理插件，支持动态世界书、记忆、角色代理与沉浸式阅读。

description.en: Tydora is a modern desktop Markdown editor with WYSIWYG editing, bidirectional links, and mind maps.
description.zh: 桌面 Markdown 编辑器，支持所见即所得编辑、双向链接、思维导图与无限画布。

description.en: Adds a SillyTavern-style roleplay frontend to dsh web with character cards, lorebooks, personas, and long-term memory.
description.zh: 为dsh web添加SillyTavern风格角色扮演前端，支持角色卡、设定集、人设和长期记忆。

description.en: Finds DSH plugins via live GitHub topic search, star-ranked, within the agent session.
description.zh: 在智能体会话内通过实时 GitHub dsh-plugin 话题搜索发现 DSH 插件，结果按星标数排序。

description.en: Replaces the DSH Web status line with an editable phrase bank, typewriter effects, day/night gradients, danmaku, themes and whale-tail motion.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web 的状态行文字换成可编辑词库，带打字机特效、昼夜渐变、弹幕、多套主题和鲸尾动画。

description.en: Headless DSH host plugin letting a phone remotely control sessions and workspaces via relay tunnel, LAN pairing and a restricted mobile API.
description.zh: 无头 DSH 宿主插件，手机可通过中继隧道、局域网配对与受限移动 API 远程操控会话和工作区。

description.en: DSH plugin that lets AI connect to databases and write SQL with real-time execution feedback for iterative optimization.
description.zh: DSH插件让AI连接数据库并编写SQL，并实时返回执行结果以迭代优化。

description.en: Domain pack for industry and company research: methodology skills, industry-chain mapping, policy/news tracking and auditable reports.
description.zh: 面向行业与公司研究的领域包：提供方法论技能、产业链梳理、公开来源政策与新闻追踪，以及可审计的研究报告。

description.en: A persistent, session-aware global download queue server for DeepSeek Harness, built around aria2 for managing downloads.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供全局、会话感知的持久下载队列服务器，基于 aria2 管理下载任务。

description.en: Two DSH agent presets for flash-level routing that cut token usage while keeping task performance.
description.zh: 面向 flash 级路由的两个 DSH agent 预设，在保持能力的同时降低 Token 消耗。

description.en: Desktop pet plugin: a cute whale girl companion for DeepSeek Harness that accompanies your coding.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的桌宠插件，在编码时显示鲸鱼娘角色陪伴。

description.en: Unofficial Project Mode for DeepSeek Harness that adds a persistent Coordinator, reusable Workers and shared context across agent sessions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的非官方项目模式，提供常驻协调者、可复用 Worker 与跨会话共享上下文。

description.en: Dispatch work to DSH agents from Claude Code/Codex with subagent progress, worker sessions, and multimodal vision/image generation.
description.zh: 从 Claude Code 或 Codex 向 DSH 智能体派发任务，支持子智能体进度、按层级预设的宿主内工作会话，并提供让纯文本框架获得视觉与图像生成能力的多模态桥接。

description.en: Builds verifiable research reports with a tamper-evident evidence ledger and per-claim citation verification verdicts.
description.zh: 构建可验证的研究报告，提供防篡改证据账本、逐条声明的引用核验结论以及密封式清单目录。

description.en: MCP server and Python SDK that generates, runs and refines AI agent workflows from natural language.
description.zh: MCP 服务器与 Python SDK，可从自然语言生成、运行并优化 AI 智能体工作流。

description.en: Galgame-style dialogue view and scene editor for DSH Web GUI session pages.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 会话页面提供 Galgame 风格对话视图与场景编辑器

description.en: Bridges Pi and DeepSeek Harness ecosystems so Pi extensions run as native DSH plugins.
description.zh: 打通 Pi 与 DSH 生态，通过统一的 Pi Host ABI 让未经修改的 Pi 扩展作为原生 DSH 插件运行。

description.en: Automatically condenses conversation-end knowledge into a local Markdown Vault with dedup, CJK search, and knowledge graph for agent recall.
description.zh: 对话结束时自动将知识沉淀到本地 Markdown 库，支持去重、中文检索和知识图谱，供 Agent 随时召回历史上下文。

description.en: AI-assisted local creator workbench for DeepSeek Harness, managing video projects as local folders.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 辅助本地创作工作台，以本地文件夹方式管理视频项目。

description.en: Renders interactive HTML cards from MCP _meta.ui in sandboxed iframes and bridges postMessage to MCP tools/resources.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 MCP Apps 宿主：在沙箱 iframe 中渲染 MCP _meta.ui 的交互式 HTML 卡片，并将 postMessage 桥接到 MCP tools/call 与 resources/read。

description.en: Gives DSH hands and eyes on Windows: capture live screen PNGs and drive the real mouse, keyboard and windows programmatically.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 桌面操控能力：截取实时屏幕画面，并以真实鼠标、键盘和窗口操作完成任务。

description.en: Adds Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models to the harness with streaming chat, thinking, tool activity, usage and in-GUI Google OAuth login.
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity（agy CLI）模型接入 Harness，支持流式聊天、思考过程、工具活动、用量统计和界面内 Google OAuth 登录。

description.en: A portable memory protocol for AI agents, providing standing rules, curation discipline, reference spec, and optional cap hook.
description.zh: 为 AI 智能体提供可移植记忆协议，可作为常驻规则加载，包含整理规范、参考规格及可选的容量上限钩子。

description.en: Dark cyber-style startup animation for DSH: badge reveal, character portrait, password gate and configurable playback.
description.zh: DSH 暗色赛博风格启动动画插件：徽章揭幕、人物立绘、访问密码与三档播放方式。

description.en: Crash-rescue plugin that snapshots config and plugin code so you can undo changes, use secret-safe backups, and boot one-click SAFE MODE.
description.zh: 崩溃救援插件：为配置与插件代码创建快照，支持撤销修改、密钥安全备份，并可一键进入安全模式启动。

description.en: Lets the agent write TSX that streams and compiles live, rendering cards inline in the conversation or in a side canvas. Uses DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 让智能体编写 TSX 并实时流式编译，卡片可内联显示在对话中或侧边画布，基于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Marketplace to browse, install, and update GitHub dsh-plugin plugins in the DSH Web GUI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中一键浏览、安装和更新 GitHub topic:dsh-plugin 下的全部插件。

description.en: Self-evolving open-source Agent OS connecting teams, AI agents, devices, and compute.
description.zh: 自演进的开源 Agent 操作系统，连接团队、AI 智能体、设备与算力。

description.en: DSH Web UI plugin that auto-sends "continue" after non-human interruptions, with error classification, backoff, pause, loop guards and stats.
description.zh: DSH 前端 UI 插件：非人为中断后自动发送「继续」，支持错误分类、自适应退避、暂停、幂等/循环保护与统计。

description.en: Tracks and reconciles token usage for DeepSeek Harness against New API and Sub2API billing relays.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 token 用量，并与 New API 和 Sub2API 中转站账单对账。

description.en: Web GUI plugin that generates and edits images from text prompts through OpenAI-compatible image endpoints, keeping shared cross-device history.
description.zh: 该插件在 Web GUI 中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口实现文生图与图生图,并提供跨设备共享的生成历史。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness web plugin with composable task controls and human-reviewed self-evolution.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 网页插件，提供可组合的任务控制，以及经人工审核的隔离式自我进化。

description.en: Shared real browser plugin for DeepSeek Harness, used for automated browsing and web searches.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的共享真实浏览器插件，用于自动浏览网页和执行网络搜索。

description.en: Mobile adaptation plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web UI, turning sidebar into overlay drawer on narrow screens.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 做移动端适配，窄屏下侧边栏变为覆盖式抽屉，会话区域独占全宽。

description.en: Lightweight Windows launcher that silently autostarts DeepSeek Harness at logon and shows a minimal WebView2 window.
description.zh: 轻量级 Windows 启动器，登录时静默自启 DeepSeek Harness，并用最小 WebView2 窗口代替完整浏览器打开。

description.en: Displays token usage heatmap, per-model breakdowns, and DeepSeek account balance in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面显示 token 用量热力图、按模型分类的用量统计以及 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: Local JSONL timing traces for AI coding agents, with red-line nudges and an evidence-backed loop that writes reviews back into agent instructions.
description.zh: 为 AI 编程助手在本地记录时间去向的 JSONL 追踪工具，通过红线提醒与数据复盘把改进写回 agent 指令/技能。

description.en: Skin center plugin that loads and renders built-in and on-demand DSH Web GUI skins from pure asset directories.
description.zh: 皮肤中心插件，从纯资源目录加载并渲染 DSH Web GUI 内置及按需安装的皮肤。

description.en: Marketplace plugin for discovering, installing, managing and updating DeepSeek Harness plugins via sidebar panel, agent tools and CLI.
description.zh: DSH 插件市场：通过侧栏面板、Agent 工具与 CLI 统一完成插件发现、安装、管理与更新。

description.en: Connects local DeepSeek Harness to IM platforms like WeChat, DingTalk, Feishu, QQ, and Telegram.
description.zh: 将本地 DeepSeek Harness 接入微信、企业微信、钉钉、QQ、飞书、Telegram 等 IM 平台

description.en: Runs standalone coding tasks on a schedule within DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中按设定时间自动执行独立的编码任务。

description.en: Renders interactive charts, forms, calculators, dashboards, and mini apps inline in assistant replies, sending actions back to the model.
description.zh: 在助手回复中内联渲染交互式图表、表单、计算器、仪表盘和小应用，并将操作反馈给模型。

description.en: Lets you ask one-off read-only side questions in DeepSeek Harness, answering from current context without tool execution.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中向当前会话提问一次性只读旁问，仅基于上下文回答，不执行工具。

description.en: MCP connector marketplace and connection manager for DeepSeek Harness Desktop, allowing users to browse, install, and manage MCP connections via OAuth, API keys, or JSON.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 提供 MCP 连接器市场与连接管理，可浏览、安装并通过 OAuth、API 密钥或 JSON 管理 MCP 连接。

description.en: Session-level superagent that polls a GitHub repo for issue/PR changes, wakes the DSH session and pushes work forward per AGENTS.md.
description.zh: 会话级 superagent：轮询 GitHub 仓库的 issue/PR，有变化即唤醒 DSH 会话，并按 AGENTS.md 主动推进工作。

description.en: Manages archived DSH sessions with view, search, restore, and delete capabilities from the settings page.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web UI 设置页查看、搜索、恢复和删除已归档的会话。

description.en: Prompt-engineering add-on for DeepSeek Harness that keeps agents persistent, applies personas, and loops in verification before finishing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供任务坚持、人格设定与完成前自检循环的提示增强插件。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that simplifies recently changed Git code while preserving behavior.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，在保留行为的前提下简化 Git 中最近更改的代码。

description.en: Rebuilds the DeepSeek Harness interface and hot-swaps plugin code in place without restarting, preserving active turns and drafts.
description.zh: 无需重启即可重建 DeepSeek Harness 界面并原地热替换插件代码，保留运行中的回合、排队消息和草稿。

description.en: DSH video skin: a looping video chat background with in-UI opacity sliders plus a skippable sound-on boot animation.
description.zh: DSH 视频皮肤：循环视频聊天背景、界面内透明度调节，以及可跳过的有声开机动画。

description.en: Layered memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that distills chats into L0–L3 memories and auto-injects relevant context before each model step.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的分层蒸馏记忆插件：后台把对话从 L0 捕获蒸馏至 L3 画像，并在模型每一步前自动召回注入相关记忆。

description.en: A pet companion for DeepSeek Harness with multi-task reminders, interactions, and Skill-based custom pets.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供宠物陪伴、多任务提醒与交互，并支持通过 Skill 自定义宠物。

description.en: Controls per-round reasoning effort (off/low/high/max) for DeepSeek Harness, with Auto mode based on tool call history.
description.zh: deepseek-harness dsh thinging levels 调整 reasoning强度调整

description.en: Injects a markdown persona card into DeepSeek Harness system prompt with live reload.
description.zh: 把 markdown 人设卡加载进 DeepSeek Harness 的系统提示词，并支持热重载。

description.en: Lets agents drive a real Chrome over CDP with remote target activation, live video/screenshot relay and login import.
description.zh: 让 Agent 通过 CDP 接入真实 Chrome，支持远程目标序列激活、实时视频/截图回传和登录导入。

description.en: Turns a sentence, text snippet or Markdown document into a playable HTML slide deck plus a fully editable PPTX, with themes, animations and bilingual output.
description.zh: 把一句话、一段文字或 Markdown 文档转成可放映的 HTML 演示页和可编辑 PPTX，支持主题、动画与中英双语。

description.en: Displays provider/model, live balance, peak/off-peak pricing with countdown, and per-session spend in a single line.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 底部信息栏插件，单行显示提供商/模型、实时余额、峰谷定价倒计时和每会话实际花费。

description.en: Sidebar dashboard that aggregates real token usage from session logs and shows DeepSeek Harness costs using a multi-provider pricing catalog.
description.zh: 侧边栏用量计费面板，从会话日志汇总真实 token 用量，并基于多提供商价格目录显示 DeepSeek Harness 花费。

description.en: Enables DSH to use GPT models via ChatGPT subscription with OAuth login, token storage, and tool support.
description.zh: 让 DSH 通过 ChatGPT 订阅使用 GPT 模型，支持 OAuth 登录、令牌存储和工具调用。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that orchestrates 7 roles across 5 stages to produce deep long-form articles with evidence base and audit.
description.zh: 论衡DeepSeek Harness插件，编排5阶段7个角色，生成带证据库与审计的深度长文

description.en: Gives DeepSeek Harness agents a persistent, cross-session, migratable long-term memory stored as a markdown and git library.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供持久化、跨会话、可迁移的长期记忆库，以 markdown 与 git 形式存储。

description.en: Plugin manager and marketplace for DeepSeek Harness: enable/disable plugins, browse plugin market, one-click install, gated upgrades with rollback.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件管理与市场：一键启用/停用插件、浏览插件市场并安装、升级门控与自动回滚。

description.en: Session manager for DeepSeek Harness that deletes conversations with confirmation and manages archives.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的会话管理器，确认后删除对话，并管理归档。

description.en: Autonomous Douyin assistant: browses the web version in Edge, samples video frames for the model, tracks interest/persona and writes daily Markdown reports.
description.zh: DSH 抖音助手：在 Edge 中自主浏览电脑版抖音，采样画面交给模型，积累兴趣与人格并生成观看日报。

description.en: Encrypted credential vault for DeepSeek Harness with AES-256-GCM and TOTP support.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的加密凭证保管库，使用 AES-256-GCM 加密并支持 TOTP，提供模型工具和设置界面。

description.en: Desktop plugin that sends a reminder when the agent needs your input or a reply finishes.
description.zh: 桌面插件，当代理需要您的输入或回复完成时发送提醒。

description.en: Static capability disclosure for DSH plugins with evidence-backed, zero-token auditing.
description.zh: 对 DSH 插件进行静态能力披露与审计，基于证据、零令牌消耗，不作安全性声明。

description.en: OAuth-based subscription management for LLM providers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OAuth 的订阅式 LLM 服务商管理，支持 Codex、Claude、Grok 和 Antigravity。

description.en: Connects ChatGPT subscription to DeepSeek Harness via OAuth, adding Codex models with Harness-native controls and session recovery.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 把 ChatGPT 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，添加 Codex 模型，并支持 Harness 原生控制与会话恢复。

description.en: Provides model-facing tools to create, read, and update Office documents (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) with safe workspace paths and PPT image embedding.
description.zh: 为模型提供创建、读取和更新 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文档的工具，限定工作区安全路径，并支持 PPT 嵌入图片。

description.en: Permission-gate plugin for DSH that controls whether a gated action is allowed to proceed, with zh/en/ja/ko docs.
description.zh: DSH 的权限门禁插件，在操作执行前进行拦截与许可控制，附带中英日韩文档。

description.en: Catppuccin theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with four flavors and glassmorphism toggle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供 Catppuccin 主题，可在 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato、Mocha 四种配色间一键切换，并支持开关玻璃质感效果。

description.en: Full Russian localization for DeepSeek Harness: 7574 keys across core and 59 plugins, live overrides, translation inspector and typography fixes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供完整俄语本地化：覆盖内核与 59 个插件共 7574 个词条，支持实时覆盖、翻译检查器与排版修正。

description.en: Official Huawei Cloud plugin for AI agents to securely build, deploy, and operate on Huawei Cloud with skills and MCP tools.
description.zh: 华为云官方AI代理插件，提供技能和MCP工具，帮助在华为云上安全地构建、部署和运维。

description.en: Turns DeepSeek Harness into an AI team mode where a team of agents carries tasks through while you set direction and approve key checkpoints.
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 变成 AI 团队模式：由多个智能体把任务做到底，你负责定方向、把关键的关。

description.en: Playwright-powered browser automation for driving real web pages: fill forms, click flows, scrape content, and capture screenshots.
description.zh: 基于 Playwright 的浏览器自动化插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 驱动真实网页：填写表单、执行点击流程、抓取内容并截图。

description.en: Bridges WeChat private chats to DeepSeek Harness for bidirectional text/media/file exchange and slash-command management.
description.zh: 将微信私聊消息桥接到DSH，支持文本、图片、文件、音视频双向传输，并提供斜杠命令管理。

description.en: Read-only runtime management panel for the DeepSeek Harness MCP client, showing status, tools, errors, and reconnect counts.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness MCP 客户端提供只读运行时管理面板，通过 /mcp 命令和设置页 MCP 标签查看状态、工具、错误与重连次数。

description.en: ACP adapter enabling Agent Client Protocol clients like Zed to use DeepSeek Harness through an ACP server.
description.zh: 实现 DeepSeek Harness 的 ACP 服务端，让 Zed 等 Agent Client Protocol 客户端通过 ACP 接入使用它。

description.en: One DeepSeek account and one instruction make every online Windows/macOS machine run the same project via a Rabbit relay.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek 账号、一条指令，通过 Rabbit 中继让所有在线 Windows/macOS 机器运行同一项目。

description.en: Local music panel for DeepSeek Harness: scan a folder, browse tracks with covers and tags, and play them in a sidebar player with playlists and synced lyrics.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的本地音乐面板：扫描文件夹、浏览带封面和标签的曲目，并在侧边栏播放器中播放，支持播放列表与同步歌词。

description.en: Telegram bot bridge that lets you drive the agent with text, voice and photos, with each forum topic as its own session and working directory.
description.zh: 一个 Telegram 机器人桥接，让你用文字、语音和图片驱动智能体，每个论坛话题都是独立会话和工作目录。

description.en: Plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness Web UI to browse GitHub dsh-plugin topic.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 设置页内浏览 github.com/topics/dsh-plugin 插件市场，支持搜索、按星数排序并查看安装说明。

description.en: Read-only Git/SVN code review plugin that reads specified changes and explicit context, reusing the host DSH agent model to report evidence-backed issues.
description.zh: 只读的 Git/SVN 代码审查插件，读取指定变更与显式上下文，复用当前 DSH Agent 模型，输出有证据、可校验位置的问题。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime for DeepSeek Harness, bundling Playwright and OpenCLI to expose a browser service and interactive browser tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自包含浏览器运行时，内置 Playwright（Chromium）和 OpenCLI 依赖，开放浏览器服务与交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: A pi-style terminal UI for DeepSeek Harness with slash commands, GitHub themes, and powerline footer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 pi 风格终端界面，支持斜杠命令、GitHub 明暗主题和 powerline 页脚。

description.en: Provides a Git Bash shell for Windows DSH agents, replacing the default pwsh executor.
description.zh: 为 Windows 上所有模式的 DSH 代理提供 Git Bash shell，替代默认的 pwsh 执行器。

description.en: Adds an indexed session-search panel to the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, toggling between title and content search with user/reply/tool filters.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏添加自带索引的会话搜索面板，可在标题/内容搜索间切换，并按用户、回复、工具筛选。

description.en: A draggable DeepSeek Harness Web pet that animates while your agent works, with replaceable character packs and a pet-maker Skill.
description.zh: 装在 DeepSeek Harness Web 里的可拖动宠物，随 Agent 工作节奏动画陪伴，支持替换角色包与制作角色。

description.en: Tavern plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling character card roleplay, worldbook management, and memory tracking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供角色卡扮演、世界书管理、预设切换、记忆摘要与关系图谱的插件，含暗色主题。

description.en: VSCode-style coding inside DeepSeek Harness: Monaco editor, agent diff review (Keep/Undo/archive), LSP intelligence, DAP debugging, SVN integration
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供类 VSCode 编码模式：内置 Monaco 编辑器、Agent 差异审查（采纳/撤销/归档）、LSP 智能提示、DAP 调试与 SVN 集成。

description.en: Dynamic plugin for DeepSeek Harness that reduces token cost while preserving model intelligence.
description.zh: 一个 dsh 动态插件，在不降低模型智能的前提下降低 token 消耗。

description.en: Persistent web search plugin with multiple engines, SQLite caching, and Playwright rendering for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化网页搜索，支持多引擎、SQLite+LRU 缓存与 Playwright 渲染。

description.en: Cross-session token usage analytics plugin for DSH with a web dashboard (ctx.tokenUsageStats).
description.zh: DSH跨会话令牌用量分析插件，提供Web仪表盘及ctx.tokenUsageStats接口。

description.en: Manages per-provider API key pools with automatic rotation on quota or rate-limit failures and live status display.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 各服务商维护 API 密钥池，遇到配额或限流失败时自动切换到下一个密钥，并在 Web UI 实时显示密钥状态。

description.en: Generates images via FAL queue API and displays them inline in conversation.
description.zh: 通过 FAL 队列 API 提供 generate_image 工具生成图片，并在对话中直接内嵌显示

description.en: A comprehensive guide and documentation archive for building DeepSeek Harness plugins, including community deep-dives and pitfalls.
description.zh: 提供构建 DeepSeek Harness 插件的完整指南与文档存档，含中英文官方文档、Cordis 入门、15 个社区仓库深入解析、20 多个实战坑点及 dsh-plugin-guide 技能。

description.en: Configures input traffic policies for working sessions, with color-coded insertion modes and peak-time session freezing.
description.zh: 打断并输入和下一轮插入不再二选一 支持红色打断插入 黄色下一自然轮插入和绿色待整个逻辑执行完成后输入 并支持邻近高峰期冻结会话在非工作高价时间再继续会话 traffic policy of woring session stream cut in slide in inputs

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness; remembers user preferences, project conventions, and facts, evolving through reinforcement and decay.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的跨会话长期记忆插件，记住用户偏好与项目约定，并通过强化和衰减演化。

description.en: In-GUI hub to browse, search, enable/disable, inspect, diagnose, and scaffold local dsh skills from the official registry.
description.zh: 在 dsh Web GUI 中提供技能中枢，可浏览和搜索本地技能目录、启用或禁用、查看正文、排查诊断并新建技能，基于官方 ctx.skills 注册表。

description.en: Guards DeepSeek API sessions by auto-pausing during peak times, weekend mode, session-level freeze, and backend auto-retry.
description.zh: 通过高峰自动暂停、周末模式、会话级冻结和后端自动重试来守护DeepSeek API会话。

description.en: DeepSeek usage sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness showing account balance, unit pricing, and peak/off-peak indicator.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 侧边栏插件，显示账户余额（官方 API）、当前单价及高峰/低谷时段标识，支持中英文界面。

description.en: Search and read Zotero papers in conversation, audit the literature trail, and browse a dedicated literature panel.
description.zh: 在对话中搜索和阅读 Zotero 论文，审查文献脉络，并浏览专用文献面板。

description.en: Email workbench plugin exposing 10 IMAP/SMTP tools for reading, searching, replying, attachments and new-mail alerts across multiple accounts.
description.zh: 邮件工作台插件，提供10个IMAP/SMTP工具，支持收发、搜索、回复转发、附件与新邮件提醒及多账号管理。

description.en: DSH workbench for creating React-based Remotion videos, with official skills, templates, asset ordering, Studio preview and local MP4 export.
description.zh: DSH 的 React 编程式视频创作工作台，内置 Remotion 官方技能、模板库、素材排序、Studio 预览与本地 MP4 导出。

description.en: Local-first cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness with automatic capture, evidence-gated recall, and source tracing.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地优先的跨会话长期记忆：自动捕获对话、生成事件与元素卡片、按证据门控召回并追溯来源。

description.en: Schedule cron tasks and run automated agents in the background for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供定时任务和后台自动化执行。

description.en: Manage local coding-agent skills: scan sources, one-click copy into DSH, install from 6600+ marketplace, and control model visibility.
description.zh: 管理本地编码代理技能：扫描来源、一键复制到 DSH、从 6600+ 技能市场安装并控制模型可见性。

description.en: Turns TiddlyWiki 5 into a persistent knowledge base for DSH, letting agents and humans read/write notes with git sync.
description.zh: 将 TiddlyWiki 5 作为 DSH 的持久化知识库，让代理和人类读写笔记并支持 Git 同步。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses local FFmpeg to probe, trim, concat, transcode, burn subtitles, extract frames and export GIFs via ten agent tools.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过十个工具调用本机 FFmpeg 完成探测、剪辑、拼接、转码、字幕烧录、抽帧与 GIF 导出。

description.en: DSH plugin that replaces the kernel boot page with a full-window video clip and dissolves into the app.
description.zh: DSH 插件，用全窗口视频替换内核启动页，随后溶解过渡进入应用。

description.en: Checks for npm updates of DeepSeek Harness, shows a locale-aware banner, and enables one-click install and restart.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 的 npm 最新版并在界面顶部横幅提示，中英文随系统语言，支持一键安装更新并重启服务。

description.en: Makes DeepSeek Harness a first-class Windows citizen with Git Bash minimal mode, install doctor, and one-command setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Windows 支持：持久化 Git Bash 精简模式、检测安装陷阱的诊断命令、一键完成安装配置

description.en: Rewinds conversation and workspace state in DeepSeek Harness using a persistent Change Ledger.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中基于持久化 Change Ledger 回退对话轮次与工作区状态

description.en: Live2D desktop pet for the DSH Web GUI: draggable, mouse-following, reacts to session state, right-click panel to change outfit.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的 Live2D 桌宠：可拖动、跟随鼠标、随会话状态换动作表情，右键面板可换装。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness with pause-based dictation and multi-provider speech recognition fallback.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供语音输入，支持按停顿分段的听写和语音消息，每条各有独立服务商回退链（Deepgram、Groq、HuggingFace、本地 whisper.cpp）。

description.en: Custom theme plugin allowing background image configuration, interface transparency, and full-color theme selection via color wheel.
description.zh: 自定义主题插件，支持背景图片配置、界面透明度调节，以及通过色轮进行全彩主题选择。

description.en: Agent plugin for DSH, OpenCode, Pi, and Codex to define custom AI roles with prompts, models, memory, permissions, and multi-agent orchestration.
description.zh: 面向 DSH、OpenCode、Pi、Codex 的 Agent 插件，可自定义 AI 角色并支持多智能体编排。

description.en: A single-persona QQ/Bilibili/Douyin chatbot agent with per-person memory, daily rhythm, proactive messaging, voice and per-function model routing.
description.zh: 单角色 QQ/B站/抖音聊天机器人：按人记忆、虚拟作息、主动开口、语音收发，并按功能选用模型与统计花费。

description.en: Adds a "start image generation mode" sidebar entry in DSH that plays a full-window transition, then opens PosterFlow.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏新增「开启生图模式」入口，播放铺满窗口的过场动画后跳转到 PosterFlow。

description.en: Adds local JSONL-backed persistent memory with embeddings and agent tools for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供基于本地 JSONL 的持久记忆、向量嵌入与智能体工具。

description.en: DSH plugin that recalls/withdraws messages and restores the state at the time the message was sent.
description.zh: DSH 消息撤回插件，撤回已发送的消息并恢复到发送该消息时的状态

description.en: HTML video creation workbench for DSH that registers 20 official HyperFrames skills, with template library, asset ordering, browser preview and local MP4 export.
description.zh: DSH 的 HTML 视频创作工作台，注册 HyperFrames 官方 20 个技能，提供模板库、素材排序、浏览器预览与本地 MP4 导出。

description.en: Full-duplex voice plugin for DSH adding streaming speech recognition input, push-to-talk, live captions, barge-in and TTS read-aloud.
description.zh: DSH 全双工语音插件，提供流式语音识别输入、按住说话、实时字幕、发声打断与回复朗读。

description.en: Knowledge-base plugin for DeepSeek Harness with local/remote SQLite storage, RAG retrieval, and web admin.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 可安装知识库插件，支持本地或远程 SQLite 存储、RAG 检索和 Web 管理界面。

description.en: A governed registry for MCP connectors (stdio/streamable-http) with four-level fail-closed authorization, loud mcpServers import errors, and full credential redaction.
description.zh: 受治理的 MCP 连接器注册表（stdio/streamable-http），提供四级 fail-closed 授权、mcpServers 导入显式报错与全程凭据脱敏。

description.en: Multi-agent mathematics problem-solving and validation framework with two architectures for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的多代理数学问题求解与验证框架，提供两种架构。

description.en: Automatic provider/model fallback chains for dsh agents when LLM requests fail.
description.zh: 为 dsh 智能体提供基于角色的 LLM 重试与备用链，请求失败时自动切换到其他供应商或模型

description.en: Configures reasoning effort levels for DSH llm-pi-ai models with bilingual settings and subagent defaults.
description.zh: 为手动声明的 DSH llm-pi-ai 模型配置推理强度等级，提供双语设置项和子代理默认值。

description.en: File-based long-term memory plugin for DSH agents, storing memories as markdown files with frontmatter for transparency and easy migration from Claude Code.
description.zh: 基于文件的 DSH 代理长期记忆插件，将记忆以带 frontmatter 的 markdown 文件存储，便于查看和从 Claude Code 迁移。

description.en: Prompt toolbox for DeepSeek Harness: 24 clickable templates, /prompt command, and smart suggestions, fully customizable.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的提示词工具箱，提供 24 条可点击模板、/prompt 命令与智能推荐，支持自定义。

description.en: Open-source Agent Skills that let AI coding agents identify, deploy, troubleshoot, verify, version and roll back applications.
description.zh: 一组开源 Agent Skills，让各类 AI Agent 完成应用识别、部署、排错、交付验证、版本管理与回滚。

description.en: Lets an agent drive DeepSeek Harness's built-in sidebar browser to navigate, read, click, type, and run JavaScript while you watch.
description.zh: 让智能体操控 DeepSeek Harness 内置侧边栏浏览器，进行导航、阅读、点击、输入和执行 JavaScript，全程可见。

description.en: File-upload plugin with drag-and-drop, content sniffing, document-to-Markdown conversion, and read_document tool.
description.zh: dsh 文件上传插件：支持拖拽或回形针上传、内容嗅探、用 MarkItDown 把文档转成 Markdown，并提供 read_document 工具。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness account monitoring and control center with usage tracking, alerts, recharge, and session management.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 账户监控与控制中心，支持用量统计、提醒、充值和会话管理。

description.en: One-click prompt enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness web GUI that rewrites composer drafts into structured prompts with preview and undo.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness Web GUI的一键提示词增强插件，将草稿重写为结构化提示词，支持预览、回填和撤销。

description.en: Adds a whale maid desktop pet to DeepSeek Harness Web UI with work stats, sleep, time, balance, weather, and feeding.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面添加蓝发鲸鱼女仆桌宠，支持工作链路、任务用时/消耗/花费统计、睡眠系统、时间感知、余额/天气/喂食按钮和设置面板。

description.en: Declarative allow/deny/ask permission rules for DeepSeek Harness tools with path/argument matching, audit logging, and hot reload.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 工具提供声明式 allow/deny/ask 权限规则，可按工具名、参数（glob/regex）和工作区路径匹配，支持审计日志与热重载。

description.en: Indexes project documents and code symbols into a persistent per-workspace memory store that agents can recall with source citations.
description.zh: 将项目文档和代码符号索引到持久化的按工作区记忆库，智能体可带出处引用地快速回忆。

description.en: Connects QQ chats to DSH sessions through the official Roost API, so incoming QQ messages are answered by the AI and sent back.
description.zh: 通过官方 Roost 接口把 QQ 消息接入 DSH 会话，让 AI 接收 QQ 消息并自动回复。

description.en: IDE-grade Git tool window for dsh-better-sidebar with branch tree, commit graph, changes, commit details, and JetBrains-style actions.
description.zh: IDE 级 Git 工具窗口，以 dsh-better-sidebar 原生标签页挂载，展示分支树、提交图谱、变更和提交详情，并提供 JetBrains 风格操作。

description.en: Adds a 'Read Aloud' button to assistant replies in DeepSeek Harness Web, using Xiaomi MiMo TTS to speak them with configurable options.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的助手回复中添加朗读按钮，调用小米 MiMo TTS 按可配置选项朗读。

description.en: Chinese UI enhancement plugin for DeepSeek Harness that localizes text, expands statistics display, and adjusts chat width.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面做中文本地化，扩展统计信息显示并调整聊天窗口宽度。

description.en: Adds 38 academic research tools for searching and retrieving papers, citations and figures across major scholarly databases.
description.zh: 提供38个原生学术工具，可在Semantic Scholar、PubMed、Google Scholar、arXiv等主要学术数据库中搜索和获取论文、引用与图表。

description.en: Checks DSH plugin upgrades, tests multi-host compatibility, validates format-1 market index, and auto-comments compatibility matrices on GitHub PRs.
description.zh: 检查 DSH 插件升级，测试多主机兼容性，校验 format-1 市场索引，并在 GitHub PR 上自动评论兼容性矩阵。

description.en: CLI toolkit that preflights, tests and releases DeepSeek Harness plugins, verifying GitHub repos and npm version availability.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 插件的预检、测试与发布 CLI 工具，可校验文件夹或 GitHub 仓库并等待 npm 版本上线。

description.en: Server card dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing live CPU, memory and disk status, with one-click xterm terminal, displayable as sidebar tab or drawer.
description.zh: 服务器卡片仪表盘，用于DeepSeek Harness，显示CPU/内存/磁盘状态，带一键xterm终端，可作为侧边栏或抽屉显示。

description.en: SkillHub plugin for DeepSeek Harness to search skills in conversation, view details, and install them to the harness skills directory.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 SkillHub 插件，可在对话中搜索技能、查看详情并安装到技能目录。

description.en: Universal vision bridge for DeepSeek Harness that adds image, PDF, OCR and diagram understanding to native models via 40+ tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的通用视觉桥接插件，通过 40+ 工具让原生模型支持图片、PDF、OCR 与图表理解。

description.en: Companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness providing ClineBot settings, quota dashboard, key saving, and model selection.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的配套插件，为 ClineBot 提供设置页面、配额仪表盘、密钥保存和模型选择。

description.en: Adds an approval workflow for agent edits with full-diff review, per-file and per-block keep/revert, plus undo and redo.
description.zh: 为智能体编辑加入审批流程，支持完整差异审查、按文件或按块保留与还原，以及撤销和重做。

description.en: Connects QQ private and group chats to a DeepSeek Harness agent over OneBot v11/NapCat, with voice, images, pokes and stickers.
description.zh: 通过 OneBot v11 / NapCat 把 QQ 私聊和群聊接入 DeepSeek Harness 的同一个 Agent，支持语音、图片、戳一戳和表情。

description.en: Installs code-server (web VSCode) as a dsh plugin for professional file editing.
description.zh: 将 code-server（网页版 VSCode）打包安装为 dsh 插件，用于实现专业的文件编辑。

description.en: Terminal-style composer for DSH with shell history, autocomplete, next-prompt prediction, selection toolbar, right-click paste, draggable chat TOC and a side-chat sidebar.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供终端风格输入框：历史记录、自动补全、提示预测、选中工具栏、右键粘贴、可拖动目录和侧边对话。

description.en: Connects Qoder (Lingma CN/international) models to DeepSeek Harness via PATs, with a multi-account pool, daily check-in, failover, and read-only credits.
description.zh: 通过 PAT 将 Qoder（Lingma 国内/国际）模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供多账号池、每日签到、自动故障转移与只读额度概览。

description.en: Claude Code-style auto-memory plugin for dsh that stores typed memory files with a MEMORY.md index auto-injected into the system prompt.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供 Claude Code 风格自动记忆：分类型记忆文件加 MEMORY.md 索引，自动注入系统提示词，纯文件无外部服务。

description.en: Read-only DSH sidebar tab that renders the session brief as a todo progress kanban plus a live deliverables list of written/modified files.
description.zh: 只读的 DSH 侧栏标签，把会话简报渲染为 todo 进展看板和实时产物列表（写入/修改的文件）。

description.en: Local Chinese web-novel writing workbench with 22 tools, on-device 24MB model, and zero API cost.
description.zh: 面向中文网文作者的本地写作工作台，含22个工具与随包本地模型，零Token、正文不出本机。

description.en: CalDAV calendar workbench for DeepSeek Harness exposing five model tools to list, create, update, delete and search events across Google, iCloud, Nextcloud or any CalDAV server.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的原生 CalDAV 日历工作台，提供 5 个模型工具，可对 Google/iCloud/Nextcloud 等服务器上的日历事件进行增删改查与搜索。

description.en: Bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness with a SQLite provider, memory tool and frozen snapshot injection.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供有界、分层、需审批且可审计的跨会话记忆，含零依赖 SQLite 提供者、记忆工具与冻结快照注入。

description.en: dsh plugin that turns PDFs into a paper-reading workbench with transcription, retrieval, streamed chat and a built-in reader page.
description.zh: dsh 插件：把 PDF 变成论文伴读工作台，支持转录、检索、流式问答与内置阅读器页面。

description.en: Text-to-speech plugin that speaks agent replies in the Web UI with provider fallback chain.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文本转语音，在 Web UI 中朗读智能体回复，支持服务商回退链。

description.en: Adds hierarchical workspace tree to sidebar; titles with / group into virtual folders.
description.zh: 在侧边栏添加分层工作区树，按 / 分组为虚拟文件夹。

description.en: DSH voice plugin adding zero-key Edge TTS speech playback, voice preview, and OpenAI-compatible ASR transcription to your agent.
description.zh: DSH 语音插件：零密钥 Edge TTS 朗读、音色试听，并兼容 OpenAI 接口的 ASR 语音转写。

description.en: Provides LSP-based tools for diagnostics, formatting, and code completion via language servers.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 LSP 工具，通过语言服务器实现 lsp_diagnostics 诊断、lsp_format 格式化和 lsp_completion 代码补全。

description.en: 34 opencode color themes for DeepSeek Harness with one-click switching and persistence.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 34 款 opencode 经典配色主题，支持一键切换并持久保存，重启不丢失。

description.en: Structured table editor for UpdateVariable blocks in DeepSeek Harness tavern plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 酒馆插件的 UpdateVariable 块提供结构化表格编辑界面

description.en: SSH ops plugin for DeepSeek Harness: drive servers from chat with live terminal, SFTP, port forwarding, and database management.
description.zh: 在对话中驱动SSH运维：右侧实时终端、SFTP传输、端口转发与数据库管理，并对高危命令做保护。

description.en: Self-hosted operations plugin for DSH Web: safe restart/recovery, health diagnostics, model usage/error stats, backups, and Linux permission repair.
description.zh: DSH Web 自托管运维插件，提供安全重启与恢复、健康诊断、模型用量与错误统计、备份以及 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Customizes DeepSeek Harness appearance with theme colors, background images, opacity/blur, and glass effect.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 定制外观：主题配色、背景图片、透明度与模糊、玻璃拟态效果。

description.en: DSH host plugin that lets AI agents recall past session memories from the same working directory on demand, read-only and non-persistent.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：让 AI 智能体按需检索同一工作目录下的历史会话记忆，只读、不落盘、不注入。

description.en: Tidy Display adds a clean reading view and a message rail to the DeepSeek Harness chat interface for easier reading and navigation.
description.zh: 整洁显示为 DeepSeek Harness 聊天界面提供整洁阅读视图和消息侧栏，便于阅读与定位。

description.en: Monitors DeepSeek Harness plugins for vulnerabilities and breaking changes in dependencies.
description.zh: 持续监控 DeepSeek Harness 插件的依赖漏洞与破坏性变更，并评估其对插件的影响。

description.en: Turns a Bilibili video into model-readable text: metadata, comments, danmaku, AI subtitles, local transcription, and frame-extraction OCR, as a DSH plugin or CLI.
description.zh: 把 B 站视频变成模型可读的内容：元数据、评论、弹幕、AI 字幕、本地转写与抽帧 OCR，既可作 DSH 插件也可当命令行工具。

description.en: Computer Use plugin for AI to control mouse and keyboard via screen observation and clicks.
description.zh: Computer Use 插件：虚拟鼠标真人操作 for DeepSeek Harness（screen_observe + computer_click 等 11 个模型友好工具，跨平台 cua-driver 引擎）

description.en: Citation workbench for DeepSeek Harness: looks up DOI metadata via Crossref, verifies and dedupes references, and exports GB/T 7714, APA, MLA, Chicago and BibTeX citations.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 引文工作台：通过 Crossref 查询 DOI 元数据，校验并去重参考文献，按 GB/T 7714、APA、MLA、Chicago 与 BibTeX 格式导出引文。

description.en: A plugin marketplace for DeepSeek Harness, automatically collecting and categorizing community plugins via GitHub Actions.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的插件市场，通过 GitHub Actions 自动收集并分类社区插件。

description.en: Unified manager for DSH MCP servers and skills, offering per-tool toggles, secret masking, and a skill recycle bin.
description.zh: 一站式管理 DSH 的 MCP 服务与 Skills，提供工具级开关、密钥打码与技能回收站。

description.en: A DSH Web plugin for editing and recalling your own chat messages inline, with lazy confirmation and zero data loss.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中就地编辑或撤回自己发送的聊天消息，带延迟确认，不丢失数据。

description.en: Windows computer-use plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness see the screen and control mouse, keyboard, windows and clipboard with per-app permission.
description.zh: Windows 电脑控制插件：让 DeepSeek Harness 看屏幕并用鼠标、键盘、窗口与剪贴板操作电脑，按应用授权。

description.en: Fetches GitHub Trending on daily/weekly/monthly cycles, writes Chinese summaries plus release digests, then auto-commits and opens a PR.
description.zh: 按日/周/月抓取 GitHub Trending，生成中文简介与 Release 摘要，并自动提交到仓库并开 PR 合并。

description.en: Adds one apply_patch tool to DeepSeek Harness for patch-style file edits using git/unified diffs, applied all-or-nothing.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一个 apply_patch 工具，支持 git/unified diff 形式的补丁式文件编辑，全部成功或全部失败。

description.en: VS Code-style IDE mode for DeepSeek Harness with Monaco editor, Git, SSH and PTY terminal, plus a docked session panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 VS Code 风格 IDE 模式：Monaco 编辑器、Git、SSH 与 PTY 终端，官方会话停靠右侧。

description.en: Continual self-evolution plugin for DeepSeek Harness with versioned, auditable state refined from session trajectories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持续自我进化能力，从会话轨迹中提炼并版本化管理可审计、可回滚的 harness 状态，并配合基准驱动的验证循环。

description.en: Renders and edits Mermaid diagrams inside DeepSeek Harness Web and Desktop with live previews, custom themes and SVG/PNG export.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页端与桌面端渲染和编辑 Mermaid 图表，支持实时预览、自定义主题和 SVG/PNG 导出。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets agents drive ComfyUI to generate and process images and videos.
description.zh: DeepSeek-Harness 插件，让智能体驱动 ComfyUI 生成和处理图像与视频

description.en: DSH plugin that shows per-project token usage, development timeline, estimated spending, plus account balance and subscription quota.
description.zh: DSH 插件：按项目统计 Token 消耗、开发时间线与预估费用，并可查看账户余额与订阅额度。

description.en: WeChat (iLink) channel plugin that lets you message the DSH Agent from WeChat and receive its replies, with text, images, files and voice notes.
description.zh: 微信（iLink）通道插件：在微信里给 DSH Agent 发消息，本机跑会话并把回复发回微信，支持文本、图片、文件和语音。

description.en: Graphical app-store for DeepSeek Harness plugins: browse, search, and one-click install GitHub dsh-plugins.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面内提供图形化插件商店，可浏览、搜索并一键安装 GitHub 上的 dsh-plugin 仓库，支持本地评分、依赖影响图、审计日志和插件脚手架指南。

description.en: Static agent roster and member-profile definitions that compile validated role files into dsh-agent-teams members for multi-agent setups.
description.zh: 静态智能体名册与成员配置插件，将校验后的角色文件编译为 dsh-agent-teams 成员。

description.en: Unified notification plugin for DSH with a single API, 8 channel adapters, and dual triggers.
description.zh: DSH统一通知插件，提供单一notify()接口，支持8种渠道适配器，并通过会话事件与智能体工具双触发推送。

description.en: Persistent WebSocket gateway for dsh, enabling mobile app access on the same network with agent output forwarding and 24 signaling commands.
description.zh: 基于WebSocket的dsh网关插件，让同一网域内的移动端App接入，转发智能体输出并处理24个信令命令

description.en: Enables conversational creation, editing, repair, and validation of Excel spreadsheets in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中通过对话创建、编辑、修复和校验 Excel 表格，支持单元格、公式、样式、筛选、表格与图表，每次修改均自动验证。

description.en: Bridge plugin to use newest Zhipu/Z.AI coding models (glm-5.3) in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供桥接，使其能在内置 pi-ai 目录更新前使用智谱/Z.AI 最新编码套餐模型（如 glm-5.3）。

description.en: Custom mode for DSH: pick a base mode, toggle plugins row by row, and edit the system prompt live from the Web settings page.
description.zh: DSH 自定义模式：选择基础模式、逐行开关插件，并在设置页实时编辑系统提示词，保存后新会话生效。

description.en: SSH session management with SFTP, proxy, port forwarding, and AI terminals for DSH.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 SSH 会话管理，支持 SFTP 文件传输、代理、端口转发和 AI 终端。

description.en: Free multi-engine web search plugin for DeepSeek Harness with automatic fallback.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免费多引擎网页搜索插件，支持 Tavily、Firecrawl、Exa、Jina、Brave 自动降级切换。

description.en: Adds a zero-dependency fast mode to DeepSeek Harness that adapts reasoning effort per step and batches parallel tool calls.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供零依赖 fast 模式：按步骤自适应思考档位，并按档位批量并行调用工具。

description.en: An engineering-discipline bundle for DSH that grills requirements, tests implementations and runs delivery quality gates before shipping.
description.zh: 一个面向 DSH 的工程纪律插件包，在交付前审查需求、检验实现并执行质量门禁。

description.en: Provider-independent DSH PDF parsing tools powered by MinerU, with caching and job management.
description.zh: 基于 MinerU 的 DSH PDF 解析工具，不依赖特定服务商，支持缓存与任务管理。

description.en: TypeScript library that patches, replaces and decorates DeepSeek Harness plugins at runtime.
description.zh: 一个用于在运行时对 DeepSeek Harness 插件进行补丁、替换和装饰的 TypeScript 库。

description.en: One-command bundle that installs 18 DeepSeek Harness plugins covering office, memory, media, DevOps and notifications, with sync and hot reload.
description.zh: 一条命令安装 18 个 DeepSeek Harness 插件的组合包，覆盖办公、记忆、媒体、DevOps 与通知，支持整包同步与热重载。

description.en: Minimalist token-saving long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with zero-LLM auto-capture, symbolic index, and evidence closure.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供省 token 的长期记忆插件，支持零 LLM 自动捕获、符号索引渐进披露和 ESR 证据闭环。

description.en: Adds a multi-view layout that shows 2-4 real chat conversations side by side in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加多视图布局，可并排显示 2-4 个真实对话窗口。

description.en: Unofficial fan-made UI theme for DeepSeek Harness based on Arknights P.R.T.S.
description.zh: 基于Arknights P.R.T.S.的非官方个人粉丝主题UI，用于DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Searches several community catalogs for DSH plugins and ranks results by relevance, trust and freshness rather than stars alone.
description.zh: 跨多个社区目录搜索 DSH 插件，按相关度、可信度和新鲜度排序，而不只看 star 数。

description.en: Provides a Mixture of Agents (MoA) workflow via /moa command with file workspaces and Live Canvas integration.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness提供混合代理(MoA)工作流，支持/moa命令、文件工作区和Live Canvas集成。

description.en: Password, shared-token, TOTP and passkey login gate for the dsh web surface, with session cookies, rate limiting and a user-management CLI.
description.zh: 为 dsh 网页版提供密码、共享令牌、TOTP 两步验证与 Passkey 登录门禁，含会话 cookie、登录限速和用户管理 CLI。

description.en: Academic writing guard that detects AI-style writing, revision residue, and defensive writing in manuscripts with humanize guidance.
description.zh: DSH 论文写作守卫：检测文稿中的 AI 文风、修改残留与防御性写作，提供人化改写指导，并在写入论文文件时通过 writing_audit 与 writing_rules 自动审查。

description.en: Engineering workflow plugin for DeepSeek Harness that manages task stages, verification records, commit checks, skills, and rules.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 工程工作流插件，管理任务阶段、验证记录、提交检查、技能与规则。

description.en: Adds an OpenCode Go model provider to DeepSeek Harness, with a live gateway model catalog and a per-conversation session header.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加 OpenCode Go 模型提供方，支持实时网关模型目录和按会话的会话头。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness appearance plugin that switches the background image automatically based on the currently active model.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 外观插件，根据当前使用的模型自动切换背景图。

description.en: Cross-session plaintext memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness; human-confirmed memory with BM25 search and forget.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话明文记忆，记忆经人工确认后保存，支持 BM25 搜索与遗忘。

description.en: Provides git-first workspace snapshots and session forks for DeepSeek Harness, enabling one-shot /rewind restore.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供以 git 为先的工作区快照和会话分叉，可在每次改动前保存并一次性回退恢复。

description.en: Settings page to browse, search, unarchive, and delete archived DeepSeek Harness chats, grouped by workspace.
description.zh: 在设置中提供一个已归档会话管理页，可按工作区分组浏览、搜索、取消归档和删除 DeepSeek Harness 的已归档聊天。

description.en: External vision model tool for DeepSeek Harness — inspect_image sends images to OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供外部视觉模型工具，inspect_image 可将图片发送到任意兼容 OpenAI 的接口，如 GPT-4o、Qwen-VL、GLM-4V、Ollama 等。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for dsh that distills past sessions into plain Markdown files, replaying a summary each new chat.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供跨会话长期记忆，把历史会话提炼成普通 Markdown 文件，每次新对话先加载记忆摘要。

description.en: DSH plugin that compresses AST context, filters test logs, and enforces token budgets for AI code tasks.
description.zh: DSH插件，压缩AST上下文、过滤测试日志并强制执行token预算，用于AI编码任务。

description.en: Adds long-lived AI companions with per-contact identities and WeChat routing to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供长期 AI 伙伴，支持独立身份与微信渠道。

description.en: Cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness: screenshot, screen reading, clicking, typing, scrolling, hotkeys and app launch, all approval-gated.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨平台原生桌面控制：截屏、读屏、点击、输入、滚动、快捷键与启动应用，均需审批。

description.en: dsh smooth stream is a plugin that adds silky, flicker-free typewriter streaming reveal to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 聊天添加无闪烁的打字机式流式显示效果

description.en: Encrypted peer-to-peer mesh that links DSH computers with mobile PWA remote control, Web Push alerts and host/client session sharing.
description.zh: 加密点对点组网连接多台 DSH 电脑，支持手机 PWA 远程操控、Web Push 推送与主机/客户端会话共享。

description.en: Runs Claude Code within DSH, preserving native agent loop, tools, skills, hooks, and MCP integrations.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中运行 Claude Code，保留其原生代理循环、工具、技能、钩子与 MCP 集成

description.en: Generates stable, editable PowerPoint files for AI agents from semantic IR to native DrawingML.
description.zh: Stable, editable PPTX generation for AI agents — semantic IR in, native DrawingML out. DSH plugin + Claude Code plugin + CLI. | 给 AI agent 的稳定可编辑 PPTX 生成：语义 IR 进，原生 DrawingML 出。DSH 插件 / Claude Code 插件

description.en: Lazy memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness that only reads on a hit, keeping resident memory at zero when nothing matches.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的惰性记忆插件，仅在命中时读取，无匹配时零常驻内存开销。

description.en: DSH plugin showing DeepSeek account balance and session token/cost with peak/off-peak billing.
description.zh: DSH 插件：显示 DeepSeek 账户余额，以及当前会话的 token 用量和费用，并按高峰与空闲时段计费。

description.en: Skills and extensions manager for DeepSeek Harness that installs Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Kimi plugin repositories directly without a DSH port.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的技能与扩展管理器，可直接安装 Claude Code、Codex、Cursor 和 Kimi 插件仓库，无需等待 DSH 移植。

description.en: Shows Z.ai, Kimi, MiMo and OpenCode Go subscription usage with quota details and cookie login beside the model selector.
description.zh: 在模型选择器旁显示 Z.ai / Kimi / MiMo / OpenCode Go 订阅用量、额度明细与 Cookie 登录。

description.en: A DSH plugin that adds hot-swappable brand skins and themes for DeepSeek Harness, working in both Web and Desktop profiles.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可热切换品牌皮肤与主题的 DSH 插件，Web 与 Desktop 两种 profile 均可用。

description.en: Lets you edit per-model reasoning-effort levels for third-party models inside the official Models page card, using a knowledge base and protocol inference.
description.zh: 在官方模型页面卡片中为第三方模型编辑推理强度等级，内置知识库与协议推断。

description.en: Node-based short-drama studio that turns a one-line idea into a storyboarded, voiced, subtitled video cut on an infinite canvas.
description.zh: 基于节点的短剧工作室：从一句话创意出发，在无限画布上产出带分镜、配音与字幕的视频成片。

description.en: Veyra gives coding agents persistent engineering memory, capturing durable lessons and RAG docs in local SQLite and recalling them via hybrid search.
description.zh: Veyra 为编码代理提供持久工程记忆，把可长期保留的经验与 RAG 文档存入本地 SQLite，并通过混合搜索自动召回。

description.en: Interactive in-browser canvas for real-time preview of HTML, React, SVG, and diagrams with SSE hot-reload.
description.zh: 交互式浏览器内画布，用于实时预览 HTML、React、SVG 和图表，支持 SSE 热重载。

description.en: Automatic model catalog synchronization for API key providers in DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 中带 API 密钥的服务商自动同步模型目录

description.en: Translates the Web UI's reasoning chains, task cards and answers into one of 8 target languages for easier reading.
description.zh: 将 Web UI 中的推理链、任务卡片和回答翻译成 8 种目标语言之一，方便阅读。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that lets AI edit your open Word, Excel and PowerPoint files with changes visible in real time.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：AI 直接编辑你打开的 Word、Excel、PowerPoint 文档，改动实时可见并支持共同编辑。

description.en: DSH-native LLM verifier that uses a separate model to review and arbitrate agent execution results via configurable web settings.
description.zh: DSH 原生 LLM 校验器，用独立模型审查并仲裁智能体执行结果，可通过 Web 设置页配置。

description.en: A DSH marketplace for browsing live sources and one-click installing SKILL.md skills and MCP connectors, effective immediately without restart.
description.zh: DSH 技能与 MCP 连接器市场：浏览实时技能源，一键安装 SKILL.md 技能和 MCP 连接器，装完即用、无需重启。

description.en: Adds arrow-key navigation to the DSH Web GUI so you can switch sessions and workspaces without a mouse.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web GUI 添加方向键导航，无需鼠标即可切换会话与工作区。

description.en: DSH web console for browsing, filtering, favoriting and bulk archiving/unarchiving/cleaning active and archived sessions, plus four session health checks.
description.zh: DSH Web 会话管理台：浏览、筛选、收藏并批量归档/取消归档/清理活跃与归档会话，并附四项会话体检。

description.en: Statically parses workspace Qoder Canvas (*.canvas.tsx) files into structured pages rendered in the DSH right sidebar.
description.zh: 静态解析工作区中的 Qoder Canvas（*.canvas.tsx）文件为结构化页面，并在 DSH 右侧边栏渲染。

description.en: Scans DSH agent preset declarations, auto-repairs mechanically fixable version breakage with atomic writes and .bak backups, reports the rest.
description.zh: 扫描失效的 DSH Agent 预设声明，自动对齐可机械修复的版本语法（原子写、.bak 备份），其余逐条报告文件与行号。

description.en: Cordis host plugin that adds a compact current-date line to the DeepSeek Harness runtime-context snapshot, with no dsh source changes.
description.zh: Cordis 宿主插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 运行时上下文快照添加一行简洁的当前日期信息，无需修改 dsh 源码。

description.en: Real-time token counting and first-token latency monitoring for DeepSeek Harness streaming responses.
description.zh: 实时统计 DeepSeek Harness 流式响应的 token 数量，并监测首个 token 的延迟。

description.en: Permanently deletes DeepSeek Harness sessions and workspaces from disk, triggered directly from the session menu.
description.zh: 从会话菜单直接永久删除 DeepSeek Harness 的会话与工作区，真正从磁盘移除。

description.en: Deep PTC adds conversation cards, a versioned project side panel, task briefs and interruptible shell jobs to DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: Deep PTC 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加对话卡片、可排序项目侧栏、任务简报与可中断的 Shell 作业。

description.en: Design canvas for DSH that places model-generated screens in device frames, lets you click any element to edit it, and offers versions, export and phone preview.
description.zh: DSH 设计画布：把模型生成的界面放进设备边框，点击元素即可编辑，并支持版本、导出与手机预览。

description.en: Auto-saves large pasted text into pastes/*.txt files and manages them with dock cards above the input box, leaving only a minimal badge in the draft.
description.zh: 自动将大段粘贴文本保存为 pastes/*.txt 文件，并在输入框上方用 dock 卡片管理，草稿中仅留最小徽标。

description.en: A DSH plugin that raises a self-growing agent whose personality emerges from its own learning, using Bilibili as an info source and fading memories.
description.zh: 一个DSH插件：养一只靠自主学习诞生人格的agent，以B站为信息源，记忆会随时间淡忘。

description.en: A curated DSH plugin marketplace that opens an AI security review session to audit a plugin's code before any official install command runs.
description.zh: 一个精选 DSH 插件市场：安装前先开启 AI 安全审查会话，读完仓库代码确认安全后才执行官方安装命令。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a config-sync health panel and generates push/pull/restore scripts to run after exiting the app.
description.zh: DSH 插件：在侧边栏加入配置同步体检面板，并生成退出应用后执行的 push/pull/restore 脚本。

description.en: Reports leftover local dsh-auth-* cookie entries in the desktop client and provides a standalone command to purge them after the client is closed.
description.zh: 报告桌面客户端中残留的本地 dsh-auth-* cookie 条目，并提供在客户端完全关闭后清除它们的独立命令。

description.en: Embeds the authentic DeepSeek web chat as a panel inside DeepSeek Harness so users can talk to DeepSeek without leaving DSH.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内嵌原汁原味的 DeepSeek 网页版聊天面板，无需离开 DSH 即可对话。

description.en: Folds sidebar add-on rows under the More row, with kept-visible rows and left/center/right alignment controls.
description.zh: 将侧边栏附加行折叠到 More 行下，支持保留可见行和左/中/右对齐。

description.en: Turns organized memory archives into an interactive star map where you click stars to read originals, plus a read tool for AI lookup.
description.zh: 星汐把整理好的记忆档案铺成一张可交互星图，点星看原文，并给 AI 提供检索原文的 xingxi read 工具。

description.en: Connects DSH to a shared team workspace for models, agent presets, and approved plugins.
description.zh: 将 DSH 连接到团队共享工作区，统一管理模型、Agent 预设和已批准插件。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory plugin that replays past sessions, distils reflections into a dream diary, writes AGENTS.md and recalls related tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 任务经验记忆插件：回放历史会话、反思提炼写入梦境日记、写入 AGENTS.md 并召回相关任务。

description.en: Connects Huawei Cloud CodeArts to DSH so you can chat with CodeArts-hosted models (GLM, Pangu, Qwen, DeepSeek) inside DSH.
description.zh: 将华为云 CodeArts 接入 DSH，可在对话窗口直接使用 GLM、盘古、Qwen、DeepSeek 等 CodeArts 提供的模型。

description.en: Organizes DSH web chat sessions: auto-folds completed rounds, adds separators, and provides a left-edge navigation bar for jumping to any conversation.
description.zh: 整理 DSH Web 会话时间线：自动折叠已完成回合、添加分隔线、左缘定位条跳转，并提供四个开关设置

description.en: DSH session dashboard that draws the current session as a seven-ring chart with a turn timeline, tool calls, tasks and approvals, updating live.
description.zh: DSH 会话仪表盘：把当前会话画成七层环 + 轮次时间线，展示工具调用、后台任务、审批与文件变更，并实时更新。

description.en: Bind your ChatGPT account via official OAuth and chat with ChatGPT models inside DSH using your Plus/Pro quota.
description.zh: 通过官方 OAuth 绑定 ChatGPT 账号，在 DSH 内使用 Plus/Pro 订阅额度与 ChatGPT 模型对话。

description.en: Native DSH Go plugin that shows a composer status strip, usage panel and per-turn cost estimate from engine-side data.
description.zh: DSH Go 原生插件：在输入框上方显示状态条、用量面板和每轮费用估算，数据来自引擎侧。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails plugin that blocks writing without approved outlines, locks settings, and runs zero-token de-AI scans with 20 novel_* tools.
description.zh: 长篇写作守门插件：细纲不批准不给写章、设定改值直接拒绝、零 token 六维去 AI 味扫描，附 20 个 novel_* 工具。

description.en: Imports old DeepSeek web chat exports (ZIP) into DSH Go native sessions so you can scroll back and keep chatting.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 导出的旧聊天 ZIP 导入 DSH Go 本机会话，可回看旧问答并继续对话。

description.en: Watches the exam page on your phone screen, recognizes each question and pops the answer as a top notification, using an optional question bank or a vision model.
description.zh: 盯住手机考试页面，识别题目后把答案以顶部通知弹出，可选用本地题库或视觉模型作答。

description.en: Aggregates many model sources behind one OpenAI-compatible endpoint so dsh plus WorkBuddy, OpenCode Zen, Codex and Kimi can use them directly.
description.zh: 把多家模型源聚合为一个 OpenAI 兼容地址，dsh 与 WorkBuddy、OpenCode Zen、Codex、Kimi 等可直接使用。

description.en: Resumable ACP subagent backend for DeepSeek Harness with a persistent chat pool, session/load reconnect and mid-turn steering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的可恢复 ACP 子代理后端，支持持久会话池、session/load 重连与回合中干预。

description.en: RSS/Atom subscription workbench for DeepSeek Harness: manage feeds, fetch and parse RSS/Atom, search, import/export OPML and expose nine model tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 RSS/Atom 订阅工作台：管理订阅源、抓取解析 RSS/Atom、检索与 OPML 导入导出，并向模型提供九个可调用工具。

description.en: Deterministic local security scanner for DSH agents: SAST rules, git-diff review, dependency/SBOM audit and fix verification with policy gates.
description.zh: 面向 DSH agent 的本地确定性安全扫描插件：SAST 规则、git diff 增量审查、依赖/SBOM 审计与修复复核，并提供策略门禁。

description.en: Reuses the local Doubao desktop client's login to serve Seed-series models as a DSH provider, with a read-only quota overview.
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端的登录态，将 Seed 系列模型接入 DSH 作为 provider，并提供只读额度概览。

description.en: Turns a chat request into finished Cheso artifacts — decks, slides, posters, images or videos — opened in the right sidebar.
description.zh: 把聊天请求转化为完成的 Cheso 作品——演示文稿、幻灯片、海报、图片或视频，并在右侧边栏打开。

description.en: Community MIT fork of Antigravity ACP for DSH that recognizes the xhigh reasoning tier without exposing it and adds context-usage anchors.
description.zh: Antigravity ACP 的 DSH 二次开源分支（MIT）：识别但不暴露 xhigh 档位，并补齐上下文用量锚点。

description.en: Dual-route Google Vertex AI and Gemini API plugin for DSH with native thinking levels, thought summaries, and signed tool-call replay.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Google Vertex AI 与 Gemini API 双路接入，支持原生思考等级、思考摘要与签名工具调用重放。

description.en: Upgrades the DSH desktop agent into a Cursor/Claude-class coding assistant for agentic coding work.
description.zh: 将 DSH 桌面端 Agent 升级为接近 Cursor/Claude 水准的编码助手，强化智能编码体验。

description.en: Media hub to search shows, novels, ebooks and papers, watch together in sync, and download books in your preferred format.
description.zh: 媒体中心：跨源搜索剧集、小说、电子书和论文，同步一起观看，并按所需格式下载书籍。

description.en: Grok-style bot teams for DSH where each bot has its own persona, model, skills and memory, with a dispatcher assigning work.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Grok 风格的机器人团队，每个机器人拥有独立人设、模型、技能和记忆，并由调度器分配任务。

description.en: Access DSH from your phone over a private device fabric with HITL approvals, file preview and out-of-band notifications.
description.zh: 通过私有设备网络在手机上远程操控 DSH，支持人工审批、文件预览与带外通知。

description.en: Signs in to ChatGPT via OAuth so your subscription's models appear in dsh's model picker, no API key needed.
description.zh: 通过 OAuth 登录 ChatGPT，无需 API Key，即可在 dsh 模型选择器中使用订阅内含的模型。

description.en: Argument-first PPT assistant preset that builds editable PowerPoint decks with native mechanism diagrams and an independent visual review pass.
description.zh: 参数优先的 PPT 助手预设，可生成可编辑幻灯片、原生机制图，并进行独立视觉审查。

description.en: Takes over context compaction, offering model-based compression with fallback models plus fast, token-free mechanical folding that can be rolled back.
description.zh: 接管上下文压缩，支持带备用模型兜底的模型压缩，以及快速、零 token 消耗且可溯洄的机械折页压缩。

description.en: Adds DeepSeek Harness composer helpers: input history, one-click Continue, and drag-and-drop queue reordering.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 编辑器添加输入历史、一键继续和拖拽重排队列等辅助功能。

description.en: Answers questions with interactive A2UI interfaces, offering 57 components, 19 chart types, tables, topology views and Mermaid diagrams.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 以交互式 A2UI 界面回答问题，内置 57 种组件、19 类图表、表格、拓扑图与 Mermaid 架构图。

description.en: Migrates a DeepSeek Harness workspace, including conversations, project files, and attachments, with path remapping.
description.zh: 迁移 DeepSeek Harness 工作区，包括会话、项目文件与附件，并重映射路径。

description.en: Cache-friendly context compaction for DeepSeek Harness that retains requirements, keeps tasks continuous, and retrieves history.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的缓存友好型上下文压缩插件，可保留需求、保持任务连续性并检索历史。

description.en: Key-free web search for DeepSeek Harness: 8 engines fused with RRF, 34 vertical sources, page fetch ladder, and Chinese relevance gating.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的免密钥网页搜索：8 个引擎 RRF 融合、34 个垂直源、页面抓取回退链与中文相关性过滤。

description.en: DSH Go native plugin that auto-discovers the phone's ADB TCP port and keeps an adb/adb pair connection alive with a status panel.
description.zh: DSH Go 原生插件，自动发现手机上的 ADB TCP 端口并保持 adb/adb pair 连接，附带状态面板。

description.en: DSH plugin that watches GitHub per session—surfacing PR reviews, CI failures and issue replies into the next turn, and waking an idle session.
description.zh: DSH 插件：每个会话独立盯 GitHub，把 PR 评审、CI 失败和 issue 回复自动带入下一轮上下文，空闲时还能自唤醒。

description.en: Adds plan-first task decomposition to DSH, then dispatches each work item to real sub-agents and tracks progress in a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加“先拆任务、再派子 Agent 执行、侧栏看进度”的能力：计划先行，最多 5 个部门子 Agent 并行并回写结果。

description.en: Whole-disk, millisecond file search with a self-built cross-platform index, agent tools and a Web search panel.
description.zh: 全盘毫秒级文件搜索，自建跨平台索引，提供智能体工具与网页搜索面板。

description.en: SSH-backed remote directories and editable local-to-remote linked workspaces for DeepSeek Harness remote development.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 SSH 的远程目录和可编辑的本地到远程链接工作区。
