description.en: Repeats test runs to detect flaky cases across vitest, jest, pytest and node:test, with history, quarantine lists and approval gates.
description.zh: 重复运行测试以识别 vitest、jest、pytest 和 node:test 中的 flaky 用例，支持历史记录、隔离清单与审批门。

description.en: Chinese metaphysics chart plugin for DeepSeek Harness with BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, LiuYao divination and Tarot readings plus an interactive panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 命理排盘插件：支持四柱八字、紫微斗数、六爻纳甲与塔罗牌，并提供 Agent 工具与可视化面板。

description.en: Brings your local Zotero library into DSH with a read-only sidebar panel and MCP tools for model-driven search and reading.
description.zh: 把本机 Zotero 文献库接入 DSH：右侧栏只读浏览与引用插入，并通过 MCP 工具供模型检索和精读。

description.en: DSH plugin giving agents seven tools to inspect Docker containers and images, read logs, exec commands and manage lifecycles with approval gates.
description.zh: DSH 的 Docker 管理插件，提供七个工具用于容器/镜像巡检、日志排查、容器内执行与生命周期管理，破坏性操作默认需审批。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin offering an image and video generation studio with an infinite canvas and clip stitching.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供带无限画布和片段拼接功能的图像与视频生成工作室。

description.en: Turns YouTube/Bilibili videos into subtitles, AI summaries, chapters, mind maps and RAG Q&A, with local Whisper/SenseVoice transcription and visual analysis.
description.zh: 将 YouTube / 哔哩哔哩视频解析为字幕、AI 总结、章节、思维导图与 RAG 追问，支持本地 Whisper/SenseVoice 转写和画面理解。

description.en: Ports the official Codex plugin suite into DSH by bulk-migrating plugin skills with frontmatter conversion and conflict detection.
description.zh: 将 Codex 官方插件全家桶一键移植到 DSH，批量转换技能 frontmatter、剔除专属文件并检测同名冲突。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory and knowledge graph for DeepSeek Harness, with hybrid BM25+dense+PPR retrieval and a forgetting curve that sinks rather than deletes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供跨会话长期记忆与知识图谱，采用 BM25+稠密+PPR 混合检索，并以遗忘曲线让记忆下沉而非删除。

description.en: Adds a Delete action to the DSH Web session menu, with a risk-consent dialog that removes the log, workspace accounting and live session state.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 会话菜单中添加删除操作，通过风险确认弹窗清除日志、工作区记账与实时会话状态。

description.en: Sends one-way text and Markdown messages to DingTalk group robots via webhook, with signature verification and credential masking.
description.zh: 通过 Webhook 向钉钉群机器人单向推送纯文本与 Markdown 消息，支持加签校验与凭证脱敏。

description.en: Provides task-scoped dynamic context and direct execution for DeepSeek Harness, built on dsh-bettertaskgraphs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供任务范围内的动态上下文与直接执行，基于 dsh-bettertaskgraphs 构建。

description.en: Windows desktop-operations plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness screenshot windows, read control trees and click or type with approval and audit.
description.zh: Windows 桌面操作插件，让 DeepSeek Harness 截图窗口、读取控件树并点击输入，支持授权审批与操作审计。

description.en: A living agent runtime for DeepSeek Harness that bundles clock, memory, persona, and WorldGem modules.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供活体智能体运行时，包含时钟、记忆、人格与 WorldGem 模块。

description.en: Gives DSH agents a fading memory, an editable personality, a shifting mood and a self-written diary that grows into ongoing intentions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供会逐渐模糊的记忆、可编辑的人格、起伏的心情，并自动写日记、长出心里惦记的事。

description.en: Adds a right-click action menu in the Trajectory view, optional stop reasons for background jobs, and an in-place plugin updater.
description.zh: 在 Trajectory 视图中加入右键操作菜单、后台任务可选的停止原因，以及原地插件更新器。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness host bundle that adds official Antigravity ACP (Gemini) as a primary model with DSH-owned tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 宿主包，将官方 Antigravity ACP（Gemini）作为主模型并搭配 DSH 自有工具。

description.en: Minimal agent preset pairing official prompts with programmatic tool calling, multi-step code execution and Windows Git Bash support.
description.zh: 极简智能体预设，结合官方提示词与程序化工具调用、多步代码执行及 Windows Git Bash 适配。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects agents to Slack bidirectionally: channel notifications, thread replies, and a Socket Mode inbox.
description.zh: DSH 插件，让 agent 与 Slack 双向通信：频道通知、线程回复，以及 Socket Mode 收件箱。

description.en: A finance-focused DSH plugin: a multi-agent investment assistant for Chinese retail investors covering CN, HK and US stock markets.
description.zh: 面向中国股市散户的金融投资智能体插件，采用多智能体协作，覆盖A股、港股、美股市场。

description.en: Adds a notification inbox to DeepSeek Harness with per-person read/unread state, Web Push to phones and browsers, and action buttons on each notification.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加通知收件箱，支持按人区分已读/未读、向手机和浏览器推送 Web Push，并为每条通知提供操作按钮。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness adapter that connects GPT/OpenAI models and Codex instructions, skills, plugin resources and MCP config.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 GPT/Codex 适配插件，接入 OpenAI 模型并加载 Codex 指令、技能、插件资源与 MCP 配置。

description.en: Locally searches your other conversations by keyword and inserts past Q&A summaries into the current input box.
description.zh: 在本地按关键词检索你其他对话中的问答，并把摘要插入当前输入框。

description.en: Compares two versions of up to 12 Git/SVN projects and exports Chinese Markdown release reports with optional AI-written interface and QA notes.
description.zh: 比较最多 12 个 Git/SVN 项目的两个版本，导出中文 Markdown 发布报告，可选由模型整理接口变更与 QA 建议。

description.en: Installs and validates PowerShell 7 for the DSH pwsh tool on Windows, checking connectivity before the Microsoft Store install.
description.zh: 在 Windows 上为 DSH 的 pwsh 工具检测、校验并安装自更新的 Microsoft Store 版 PowerShell 7，安装前先检查连接。

description.en: Academic plugin for DeepSeek Harness: search your Zotero library and annotations, query arXiv/OpenAlex/Crossref/PubMed and other paper sources, and verify references.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 学术插件：检索 Zotero 文库与批注，同时查询 arXiv、OpenAlex、Crossref、PubMed 等论文源，并核验参考文献。

description.en: Multi-agent engineering workflow for DSH with seven roles, four flow profiles, human approval gates, guards, and a git asset repo that stores specs and memory.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的多智能体工程工作流，包含七种角色、四种流程配置、人工审批关卡、防护机制，以及随任务归档积累规格与记忆的 git 资产库。

description.en: All-in-one DSH dashboard to manage MCP servers, skills and WorkBuddy experts, with a tool-usage ledger and one-click marketplace installs.
description.zh: DSH 一体化看板：集中管理 MCP、技能与 WorkBuddy 专家，附工具账本与市场一键安装。

description.en: Switches the DSH sidebar between three layouts — tabs, floating overlay and the official default (the host's built-in collapsed sidebar) — with a graphical setting for the default mode, plus always-expanded session lists and temp sessions that are deleted on exit.
description.zh: 在 DSH 左侧栏的三种布局之间一键切换：标签页、浮层、官方默认（宿主原生的折叠侧栏），可在详情页直接设置默认布局；另含会话列表默认全展开、临时会话退出即删等设置。

description.en: Wallpaper background plugin for DeepSeek Harness UI with built-in, custom upload, and Wallpaper Engine sources.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面提供壁纸背景，支持内置壁纸、自定义上传和只读 Wallpaper Engine 库，可渲染图片、视频和场景预览，并调节遮罩、模糊、亮度和安全缩放。

description.en: Adds a VS Code-style local development workbench to DeepSeek Harness with file explorer, editor, search, Git, and preview.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中加入 VS Code 风格的本地开发工作台，包含文件浏览器、编辑器、搜索、Git 和预览功能。

description.en: Injects a private-sandbox framing line into every request, plus persona presets and settings, to reduce model refusals.
description.zh: 在每次请求中注入“私有沙盒”提示语，并提供预设角色与设置页，以降低模型的拒绝倾向。

description.en: Uses Claude Code CLI as a dsh LLM provider with live model lists, session resume, approval relay, images, and memory/rewind panels.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code CLI 作为 dsh 的 LLM 提供方，支持实时模型列表、会话续接、审批转发、图片和记忆/回退面板。

description.en: A local-first DSH memory plugin for long-form roleplay and companion chats, giving AI characters fading, uncertain, knowledge-limited recall.
description.zh: 面向长篇 RP 与陪伴对话的本地优先 DSH 记忆插件，让 AI 角色拥有会淡忘、会不确定且只知其应知之事。

description.en: File-based experience cards that inject a one-line pointer (not the full card) when a matching tool error occurs, with hit stats, rarity, sync and a community library.
description.zh: 基于文件的经验卡片：当工具报错匹配时只注入一行卡片指引入口，附带命中统计、稀有度、跨机同步与社区库。

description.en: A local-first podcast player for DeepSeek Harness that plays audio files from your disk with subtitles, transcription and translation.
description.zh: 本地优先的播客播放器，可播放磁盘上的音频文件，支持字幕、转写与翻译。

description.en: Connects PCs and phones into a multi-node AI mesh for cross-device delegation and direct desktop control.
description.zh: 将电脑和手机连接成多节点 AI 网络，实现跨设备任务委派和桌面直接控制。

description.en: Integrates Ollama local models into DeepSeek Harness, enabling model discovery, routing, and status checks.
description.zh: 把本地 Ollama 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，可发现、拉取、删除和查看本地模型，按任务类型或关键词路由请求，失败时自动回退云端，并用 /ollama 查看状态概览。

description.en: A DSH bundle adding three agent presets (software dev, game dev, read-only discussion), six bundled skills, and session-isolation toggles.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件包，提供三个 Agent 预设（软件开发、游戏开发、只读讨论）、六个内置技能，以及会话隔离开关。

description.en: A panoramic console for DeepSeek Harness that runs many sessions and subagents in parallel, shows the agent graph, and warns before context is lost.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全景控制台：并行运行多个会话与子代理，展示代理图谱，并在上下文丢失前预警和交接任务。

description.en: Web panel that drives local DaVinci Resolve Studio via MCP for footage preflight, LOG restoration and 15-node color grading with a 10-look style library.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 驱动本机 DaVinci Resolve Studio 的网页控制台，完成素材预检、LOG 还原、15 节点调色与 10 款风格库一键应用。

description.en: Portable Roblox development preset for DeepSeek Harness with native workers, role-aware routing and upstream Roblox skills.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的便携式 Roblox 开发预设，提供原生 worker、角色感知路由和上游 Roblox 技能。

description.en: Unified @ mention picker for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with five built-in categories, bundled @git, and per-plugin categories.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页 GUI 提供统一的 @ 提及选择器，含五个内置分类、内置 @git 以及插件自带分类。

description.en: DSH plugin that binds a separate DeepSeek API key to each workspace or single session, managed from a sidebar panel.
description.zh: 为每个工作区或单个会话绑定独立 DeepSeek API Key 的 DSH 插件，并提供侧边栏分配面板。

description.en: A DSH Web GUI plugin that adds an IDE-style Git panel with branch list, commit graph, staging/commit/amend and syntax-highlighted diffs.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 插件，在工作区提供 IDE 风格 Git 面板：分支列表、提交历史图、暂存/提交/amend 与语法高亮差异对照。

description.en: Full-duplex voice control for DSH: speak to type, send tasks and switch sessions, plus short spoken result announcements.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供全双工语音操控：开口输入、发送任务、切换会话，任务完成后还会简短播报结果。

description.en: DSH skill that builds Chinese videos end-to-end: script, edge-tts narration, timeline, frame rendering, ffmpeg encoding, mixing and QC.
description.zh: DSH 技能插件：从剧本到中文成片，涵盖 edge-tts 旁白、排轴、逐帧渲染、ffmpeg 编码、混音与质检。

description.en: Local-first memory nebula for DeepSeek Harness with a memory graph, recall, path finding, hygiene and snapshots.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的本地优先记忆星云，提供记忆图谱、召回、路径查找、清理与快照。

description.en: Animated desktop companion for DeepSeek Harness that delivers task notifications and supports session chat.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的动画桌面伙伴，可推送任务通知并支持会话聊天。

description.en: Toolbox panel for DSH Web that manages MCP servers, tools and skills with markets, import, scopes and auto-invocation settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供工具箱面板，用于管理 MCP 服务器、工具与技能，支持市场、导入、作用域与自动调用设置。

description.en: Native DSH sidebar panel that previews Markdown with offline Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math and code highlighting.
description.zh: DSH 原生右侧 Markdown 预览面板，内置离线 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 公式与代码高亮渲染。

description.en: Syncs DeepSeek Harness sessions across devices through a dedicated git mirror using append-only, keep-both conflict resolution via /sync and sync_* tools.
description.zh: 通过专用 git 镜像在多设备间同步 DeepSeek Harness 会话，采用只追加、两边都保留的冲突处理方式，并提供 /sync 命令与 sync_* 工具。

description.en: Inspect and control DSH session context injections before the first request, with content browser, trends, event logs, health checks, presets and token budget.
description.zh: 在首次请求前查看并控制 DSH 会话的上下文注入，提供内容浏览器、趋势、事件日志、健康检查、预设与 Token 预算。

description.en: Adds split-screen workspace layouts to DSH Desktop with unlimited native panes, side-by-side, stacked and 2x2 grids, plus drag-to-rearrange.
description.zh: 为 DSH Desktop 提供分屏工作区：无限原生窗格、并排/堆叠/2x2 网格布局，并支持拖拽重排。

description.en: Restarts DSH only when every conversation is idle, then auto-resumes interrupted sessions and re-arms goals so work continues.
description.zh: 等所有对话空闲后才优雅重启 DSH，重启后自动恢复被中断的会话并重新武装目标，让工作继续。

description.en: A DSH novel-writing workbench for drafting chapters, managing character and world settings, and planning plot with AI discussion.
description.zh: 催更姬是 DSH 的小说写作工作台，可写正文、管理人物与世界设定、规划情节，并与 AI 讨论、续写和改稿。

description.en: Widens the DSH workspace sandbox writable scope from one primary root to a primary root plus N additional roots, managed via a root registry and browser panel.
description.zh: 将 DSH 工作区沙箱的可写范围从单一主根扩展为主根加 N 个附加根，通过根注册表与浏览器面板管理。

description.en: Adds session deletion to DSH with a local recycle bin, recoverable deletes, undo toast, and explicit permanent deletion.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加会话删除功能：删除即移入本机回收站、可恢复撤销，并提供显式彻底删除。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness code-review plugin that finds concrete defects, cross-verifies evidence, grades risk, tracks fixes and enforces quality gates.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 代码审阅插件，独立发现缺陷、复核证据、风险分级、跟踪修复并执行门禁校验。

description.en: DSH Web GUI plugin that rewrites draft prompts into structured prompts with a result card, apply, copy, regenerate and undo.
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 提示词增强插件，一键将草稿改写为结构化提示词，支持结果卡、回填、复制、重新生成与撤销。

description.en: Adds a Lead mode to DSH: an agent preset, a working-method skill, a dependency self-check and reminders to enable the official Agent Teams.
description.zh: 为 DSH 增加 Lead 模式：包含 agent 预设、工作方法 skill、依赖自检，以及提醒启用官方 Agent Teams。

description.en: A DSH plugin that guides you through hatching a chatty AI fish pet that grows a personality, learns on Bilibili and reports back daily.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过可视化引导孵养一条会聊天、有性格、会去 B 站学习并每天汇报的 AI 大肥鱼。

description.en: Connects the self-hosted Psapi relay into DSH: sign in once, auto-create an API key, sync upstream models, and show balance, usage, subscription and top-up.
description.zh: 把自建 Psapi 中转站接入 DSH：填一次邮箱密码即自动建密钥、同步上游模型，并在同一面板显示余额、用量、订阅与充值。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin wrapping the ppt-master skill set to generate PowerPoint decks, with three lifecycle tools and optional venv isolation.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，封装 ppt-master 技能集以生成 PowerPoint 演示文稿，提供三个生命周期工具和可选的 venv 隔离。

description.en: Bridges OpenCode's free models into DeepSeek Harness by emulating the official OpenCode client protocol, no API key needed.
description.zh: 通过模拟 OpenCode 官方客户端协议，在 DeepSeek Harness 中免费使用 OpenCode 模型，无需 API Key。

description.en: A sidebar design-style library with 84 brand design languages that feeds full design tokens into the chat to generate web pages, slides and infographics.
description.zh: 侧栏设计风格库，内置84套品牌设计语言，将完整设计token送入对话以生成网页、幻灯片和信息图。

description.en: Turns local video files and Bilibili links into one searchable library, with transcripts, OCR, and multi-video comparison.
description.zh: 将本地视频与B站链接整合为统一可搜索的视频库，支持转录、OCR识别与多视频对比阅读。

description.en: Adds a Prompt manager to the DSH Web GUI Settings to browse, search, override and roll back the system prompt assembled each turn.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 设置中新增提示词管理器，可浏览、检索、覆盖并回滚每轮会话装配的系统提示词。

description.en: Replaces the reasoning-effort level picker in the DSH model menu with a pixel-mosaic particle track that scatters as effort rises.
description.zh: 把 DSH 模型菜单里的推理等级选择换成像素马赛克粒子轨道，等级越高粒子越向左散开。

description.en: Agent-led audio production toolkit for building sampled instruments, timeline arranging, sound effects, TTS, multitrack mixing and video muxing.
description.zh: 由智能体驱动的音频制作工具包，支持采样乐器、时间线编排、音效、语音合成、多轨混音与视频封装。

description.en: Collects images from DeepSeek Harness sessions and project folders into a per-project gallery with hover previews and the original conversation context.
description.zh: 把会话中和项目目录里的图片按项目汇总成相册，悬停可预览，点开可看到当时的对话与进展。

description.en: Native dsh-go plugin that auto-discovers a phone's ADB TCP port and keeps the adb connection alive for the agent.
description.zh: DSH Go 原生插件：自动发现手机的 ADB TCP 端口并保持 adb 连接不中断。

description.en: Configures personalization settings for the DeepSeek agent, including nickname, response style, tone, and custom commands.
description.zh: 配置DeepSeek智能体的个性化设置，包括昵称、回复风格、语气和自定义命令。

description.en: CAD plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 2D/3D viewer and parametric modeling using OCCT kernel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 OCCT 内核的二维/三维查看器与参数化建模功能的 CAD 插件。

description.en: Sends desktop notifications when a turn finishes, a question waits, or an approval waits; click the banner to open the Session.
description.zh: 在回合结束、有提问待答或审批待处理时发送桌面通知，点击横幅即可打开对应会话。

description.en: Adds better streaming text animation to DeepSeek Harness for improved display.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 添加更流畅的流式文字动画效果，改善输出显示。

description.en: A standalone blue-whale desktop pet for DSH with 104 animations and TTS voice that reacts to your DSH activity.
description.zh: 独立的蓝色鲸鱼娘桌宠，自带 104 个动作与语音，会跟随 DSH 的工作状态切换动画。

description.en: Adds one-click plugin upgrades, version history, and rollback directly to the DeepSeek Harness Plugins page.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 插件页面提供一键升级、版本历史和回滚功能。

description.en: Adds customizable inline emojis to AI replies via semantic markers like ::happy::.
description.zh: 通过 ::happy:: 这类语义标记，为 AI 回复自动插入可自定义的行内表情

description.en: Connects Magpie gateway models into DeepSeek Harness's model selector, with auto-sync, image input and thinking levels.
description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关上的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness 的模型选择器，支持模型自动同步、图片识别和思考档位。

description.en: A lazy senior engineer skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, ported from ponytail with 6 Chinese skills.
description.zh: 将 ponytail 的懒惰资深工程师模式完整移植到 DeepSeek Harness，含 6 个中文 Skill

description.en: Switches any existing DSH session to a different built-in agent mode on the fly, hot-swapping its toolset and system prompt without a new chat.
description.zh: 在任意现有 DSH 会话中即时切换到其他内置 Agent 模式，动态重组工具集与系统提示词，无需新建会话。

description.en: Read-only DSH web plugin for viewing Git/SVN file changes, diffs, commit history, blame and file history.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中只读查看 Git/SVN 文件变更、差异、提交历史、Blame 与文件历史的插件。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Polza.ai, giving access to 290+ models with ruble billing, Polza account login, balance and model picker.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Polza.ai，提供 290+ 模型、卢布计费、Polza 账号登录、余额查看与模型选择。

description.en: Android app plus DSH plugin that exposes the localhost-only dsh web to the LAN with a QR code and optional password.
description.zh: Android App 加 DSH 插件，把仅监听 127.0.0.1 的 dsh web 通过二维码和可选密码暴露到局域网。

description.en: Plan-only main agent with a plan-mode toggle that delegates work to workers on a switchable default route for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的仅规划主代理，带计划模式开关，可将任务委派给可切换默认路由上的工作代理。

description.en: Adds one-click session deletion to DeepSeek Harness, recursively removing sub-sessions, logs, caches, search index and workspace records.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 补上侧栏一键删除会话，递归清理子会话、日志、缓存、搜索索引与工作区记账。

description.en: Gitea/Forgejo toolkit for DeepSeek Harness to manage issues, pull requests, CI, releases, and operations.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的 Gitea/Forgejo 工具包，管理问题、拉取请求、CI、发布和操作。

description.en: Bridges Telegram to DeepSeek Harness for messaging, session management, and TTS voice notes.
description.zh: 将 Telegram 与 DeepSeek Harness 桥接，支持会话管理、steer 转向控制与 TTS 语音消息发送

description.en: Lets a text-only agent watch a video with you segment by segment, delivering spoken lines and subtitles at the right second.
description.zh: 让只会读文字的模型跟着你的真实播放进度一段段看视频，按秒对齐台词与字幕。

description.en: Offline Chinese-first UI/UX design intelligence library offering design recommendations, reviews, and search.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的离线中文优先 UI/UX 设计智能库，内置 67 种设计风格、161 个调色板、57 组字体搭配、99 条 UX 规范、25 种图表类型和 22 个技术栈，并提供 design_recommend、design_review、design_search 模型工具。

description.en: Deep reading & summarization workflow for books, papers, videos, and web content, with MapReduce deep-read and JSON Schema output, Obsidian-ready.
description.zh: 面向书籍、论文、视频和网页的深度阅读与摘要工作流，通过插件解析器、MapReduce 深度阅读和 JSON Schema 输出，可直接用于 Obsidian。

description.en: Local SQLite-backed document knowledge base for DSH with hybrid semantic and keyword search, citation-aware injection and index diagnostics.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供的本地文档知识库，基于 SQLite 索引，支持语义与关键词混合检索、引用注入与索引诊断。

description.en: Lets DSH/Codex drive SolidWorks and AutoCAD through on-demand skills and MCP servers for real CAD automation on Windows.
description.zh: 通过按需技能与 MCP 服务器，让 DSH/Codex 在 Windows 上驱动 SolidWorks 与 AutoCAD，实现真正的 CAD 自动化。

description.en: Long-running autonomous execution plugin that plans parallel subtasks from one goal and merges them into a single durable report.
description.zh: 长时自主执行插件：从一个目标出发规划并行子任务，并汇总为一份可跨重启持久化的报告。

description.en: AI workflow manager that watches your pipeline, schedules and tracks subagents, and halts runaway runs before they reach you.
description.zh: 由 AI 全程托管工作流：自动盯流程、调度并跟踪子代理，跑飞时先拦截再交给你决策。

description.en: Recall, edit-and-resend, and regenerate DeepSeek Harness chat messages.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 对话消息提供撤回、编辑后重发和重新生成功能，支持网页端与桌面端。

description.en: HTTP ingress plugin that lets AstrBot (QQ/OneBot/official IM) drive a local DeepSeek Harness agent.
description.zh: HTTP 入口插件，让 AstrBot（QQ / OneBot / 官方 IM）驱动本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体。

description.en: CTF blue-team defense console that orchestrates six defensive sub-agent roles and logs assets, alerts, IOCs and evidence into a local SQLite fact base.
description.zh: CTF蓝队防御指挥台：编排六个防守子智能体角色，并将资产、告警、IOC与取证证据实时写入本地SQLite事实库。

description.en: Formats DSH replies into structured output with no-label title cards, tables, lists, and steps, toggleable per session.
description.zh: 将 DSH 回复格式化为结构化输出，支持无标签标题卡、表格、列表和步骤，并可按会话切换。

description.en: Deterministic context compression backend for DeepSeek Harness that compresses conversation without LLM calls, preserving hard info verbatim.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性上下文压缩后端，不调用大模型即可压缩对话，并逐字保留关键信息。

description.en: DSH plugin adaptation and breaking-change checker that follows upgrade guides and npm dist-tags, plus a zero-dependency scaffolder generating five skeleton forms.
description.zh: DSH 插件适配与破坏性变更核查工具，自动跟进升级指南和 npm dist-tags，并提供零依赖脚手架生成五种骨架。

description.en: Edit already-sent chat messages, branch the conversation from that point, and browse versions with a tree view and placement presets.
description.zh: 编辑已发送的聊天消息并从该处分叉对话，提供版本计数、树状视图和位置预设。

description.en: Shows the real upstream provider and model chosen by a Magpie routing group directly in the composer dock.
description.zh: 在输入区停靠栏中显示 Magpie 路由组实际选中的上游服务商与模型。

description.en: DSH plugin for Qizhou CNC CAM with NC toolpath recognition, 3D preview and a full G-code editor.
description.zh: DSH 插件：启舟 CNC CAM，支持 NC 刀路识别、3D 预览与完整 G 代码编辑器。

description.en: Monitors server resources — CPU, memory, disk, GPU/NPU/DCU, processes and Docker — inside the DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内监控服务器资源：CPU、内存、磁盘、GPU/NPU/DCU、进程与 Docker。

description.en: Standalone narrow-screen mobile page for DeepSeek Harness with conversations, attachments, approvals and workspace file browsing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的窄屏专用移动端页面，支持会话、附件、审批和工作区文件浏览，桌面端零改动。

description.en: Web annotation plugin for DSH: select text, add note, send as message, and link replies to annotations.
description.zh: DSH 网页选中批注插件：选中文字加批注随消息发送，气泡隐藏批注块，回复按 Annotation N 逐条对照并悬浮芯片。

description.en: A DSH QQ bot extension adding unified two-layer memory, per-group isolation, token saving, sticker packs and Bilibili sharing.
description.zh: DSH QQ 机器人扩展：统一双层记忆、按群隔离、省 token、表情包与 B 站分享。

description.en: CLI health-check tool that audits whether DSH plugins are still loading after upgrades or config edits, scoring read-only and offering restorable cleanup.
description.zh: 命令行体检工具，检查升级或改配置后 DSH 插件是否仍在加载，并给出只读评分与可还原清理。

description.en: Chrome extension plus DSH plugin that lets the harness control and debug the browser; an early work-in-progress release.
description.zh: Chrome 扩展与 DSH 插件，让 harness 能够控制并调试浏览器，目前为早期开发版本。

description.en: A DSH sidebar plugin for managing Skills and MCP servers, with symlink sync and app import.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 侧边栏插件，用于管理 Skills 和 MCP 服务器，支持软链接同步与应用导入。

description.en: Windows desktop file explorer for DSH that browses local disks and session workspaces, previews files and drags them into chat.
description.zh: 适用于 Windows 桌面端的 DSH 工作区资源管理器，可浏览本机磁盘与会话工作区，预览文件并拖入对话。

description.en: Sidebar session management: sorts workspace groups by recent activity, folds stale sessions, flags running/unread/follow-up states, and adds recoverable trash.
description.zh: 侧栏会话管理：工作区分组按最近活跃排序、过期历史自动折叠、三色状态标记、置顶汇总，并删除到可恢复回收站。

description.en: Integrates a PackyCode API key into DeepSeek Harness with multi-protocol model routing, ordered API-key rotation, and balance display.
description.zh: 将 PackyCode API 密钥集成到 DeepSeek Harness，支持多协议模型路由、有序密钥轮换和余额显示。

description.en: Android APK reverse-engineering skill that unpacks, decompiles, audits, patches, re-signs and verifies apps on real devices.
description.zh: 安卓 APK 逆向技能包：解包、反编译、安全审计、打补丁重签，并在真机上验证。

description.en: Adds cross-session memory to DeepSeek Harness via Hindsight, with /hindsight commands and recall/remember/forget agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Hindsight 的跨会话记忆，包含 /hindsight 命令与记忆召回、写入、遗忘等工具。

description.en: Turns failed-then-fixed tool calls into reusable rules that are injected into coding agents before the same pitfall repeats.
description.zh: 把失败后修复的工具调用转化为可复用规则，在编码代理重蹈覆辙前自动注入提醒。

description.en: Adds a goal-mode and autonomous execution mode to DeepSeek Harness, showing a persistent status banner at the top.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加目标模式和自主执行功能，并显示置顶状态横幅。

description.en: Obsidian-compatible long-term memory vault for DSH with local Markdown storage, sidebar management, token-budgeted recall, and durable journal outbox.
description.zh: Obsidian 兼容的 DSH 长期记忆库，支持本地 Markdown 存储、侧边栏管理、按 token 预算召回和持久日志发件箱。

description.en: Presets 36 Alibaba Bailian (DashScope) models for DSH with reasoning-effort tuning, context windows, and auto-adaptation of existing routes.
description.zh: 为 DSH 预置 36 个阿里百炼（DashScope）模型，含推理强度适配、上下文窗口与已有路由自动适配。

description.en: A WeChat-friendly project assistant that keeps project memory, builds briefings from email, calendar, notes and todos, and follows up on assigned next steps.
description.zh: 长在微信里的项目助理：维护项目记忆，汇总邮件、日历、笔记与待办生成简报，并跟进交办事项。

description.en: Version-aware adapter registry that decouples third-party Cordis plugins from dsh's internal service names, paths, and RPC internals.
description.zh: 基于版本感知适配器注册表，为 dsh 的 Cordis 插件提供运行时兼容层，使第三方插件与内部服务名、模块路径及 RPC 细节解耦。

description.en: TTS plugin for DeepSeek Harness integrating local GSV-TTS-Lite engine for voice synthesis.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入本地 GSV-TTS-Lite 引擎的语音合成插件，提供文本转语音能力。

description.en: FinTax workbench plugin that answers tax-policy questions from an IMA knowledge base and runs cross-border e-commerce compliance checks and tax calculators.
description.zh: 财税工作台插件：基于 IMA 知识库做政策引证问答，提供跨境电商合规自查与确定性税额试算。

description.en: Archives original pre-compaction context locally with pointer summaries and time-weighted keyword/date recall.
description.zh: 在上下文压缩前将原文归档到本地，生成指针摘要，并支持按关键词或日期加权召回。

description.en: Connects ExoMind's server-side knowledge flywheel to DeepSeek Harness, giving agents search, entity lookup and deep Q&A over your personal knowledge base.
description.zh: 把 ExoMind 知识飞轮接入 DeepSeek Harness,为 agent 提供检索、实体查询与深度问答三个工具,直接调用个人知识库。

description.en: Aggregates 30k+ DSH plugins from dshmarket, plugin shops, official lists and npm into one ranked, de-noised leaderboard with AI picks and one-click install.
description.zh: 把 dshmarket、插件商店、官方与 npm 的 3 万多个 DSH 插件汇总成一个去噪排名榜，提供 AI 精选与一键安装。

description.en: Astrophotography planner ranking 18 celestial and deep-sky targets across 173 sites nationwide using light pollution, moon phase, weather and 3D sky simulation.
description.zh: 星野计划：按18类天象与深空目标、全国173个站点，结合光污染、月相、星历与天气推荐排序，并提供3D天球模拟。

description.en: GUI-based skill pool for DSH: import skills from files, ZIP, GitHub or GitLab, group them by repo, and control which agent modes and workspaces load each skill.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的技能池插件：从文件、ZIP、GitHub 或 GitLab 导入技能，按仓库分组管理，并通过图形界面指定每个技能在哪些 Agent 模式和空间生效，无需配置文件。

description.en: Community-maintained WorkBuddy and WorkBuddy AI model provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness, derived from corrinehu's MIT-licensed connector.
description.zh: 社区维护的 WorkBuddy / WorkBuddy AI 模型提供方插件，用于 DeepSeek Harness，源自 corrinehu 的 MIT 许可连接器。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness sidebar panel that aggregates free credit balances and daily check-in status across installed platform plugins, with manual check-in buttons.
description.zh: 一个侧栏面板，聚合展示各平台插件的白嫖积分余额与每日签到状态，并提供手动签到按钮。

description.en: Sidebar dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing peak/valley pricing, today's spend, tokens, budget runway and balance from local session logs.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的侧栏用量仪表盘，基于本地会话日志展示峰谷时段、今日花费、tokens、预算可撑天数与余额。

description.en: A language-practice page for DeepSeek Harness with a daily plan, review cards, a speaking recorder with speech analysis, writing answers and progress tracking.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的语言练习页面，包含今日计划、复习卡片、带语音分析的朗读录音、写作作答和进度追踪。

description.en: Generates images from chat by calling local or LAN ComfyUI workers, with status, generate and queue actions.
description.zh: 在聊天中调用本地或局域网 ComfyUI 工作节点生成图片，支持状态查询、生成和队列操作。

description.en: Optional DSH Web profile bundle offering six selectable wallpaper themes with palettes, previews, gold accents, glass surfaces, and a licensed display font.
description.zh: 可选的 DSH Web 配置包，提供六种可选壁纸主题，含配色、预览、金色点缀、玻璃质感与授权显示字体。

description.en: Adds a Tower mode to DeepSeek Harness for running multi-agent missions with worktree isolation and review-gated merges under human control.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 增加 Tower 模式，支持多智能体任务、工作树隔离和人工把关的评审合并。

description.en: AI-native workbench turning Feishu requirement/task tables into checklists, kanban boards and progress tracking, with an expert AI team running analysis, dev, review and QA.
description.zh: AI 原生工作台：把飞书需求/任务表转成汇总清单、看板和进度，并由专家团 AI 完成需求分析、开发、评审到 QA 全流程。

description.en: Quote any text in chat to ask about it in place, with green-underline highlights, saved Q&A pairs and cross-session search.
description.zh: 在对话中引用任意文本就地提问，支持绿色下划线高亮、问答留存与跨会话搜索。

description.en: Multi-user login gateway for DeepSeek Harness Web GUI with per-user conversation isolation and user management.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 提供多用户登录网关，包含登录拦截、按用户隔离会话以及界面内用户管理。

description.en: DSH font plugin: set body/code font families, global font-size offset and weight, with Latin/CJK split pickers and live preview.
description.zh: DSH 字体插件：设置正文与代码字体族、全局字号偏移和字重，支持西文/中文分栏选择与实时预览。

description.en: Persistent PowerShell (pwsh_run) session tool for DeepSeek Harness, plus a C shim giving the bash tool a real write boundary under WSL.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久化 PowerShell 会话工具（pwsh_run），并附带 C shim 在 WSL 下为 bash 工具建立真正的写入边界。

description.en: DSH tool manager that toggles and groups tools per Agent Preset and loads low-frequency tools on demand to cut context usage.
description.zh: DSH 工具管理插件：按 Agent Preset 开关与分组工具，并像 Skill 一样按需加载低频工具，减少上下文占用。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns a solo AI chat into an AI dev team with a project manager who splits work, hires employees and reviews results.
description.zh: 一个把「单人跟 AI 聊天」升级为「带团队做事」的 DSH 插件，由项目经理拆活、招人并验收，员工各自拥有子工作区。

description.en: PII masking middleware that swaps names, phones, emails, IDs, cards, keys and addresses for placeholders before they reach the model, then restores them on display.
description.zh: PII 脱敏中间件：在请求到达模型前将姓名、电话、邮箱、证件号、银行卡、密钥和地址替换为占位符，并在展示层还原。

description.en: Embeds the real chat.deepseek.com web app in a DSH sidebar, binding one DeepSeek conversation per session and quoting messages into its composer.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏中嵌入真实的 chat.deepseek.com 网页应用，为每个 DSH 会话绑定一个 DeepSeek 对话，并可将选中消息以引用块推送到输入框。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness coding plugin that cuts response time 48% and tokens 45% while boosting SWE-bench Pro accuracy by 10%.
description.zh: 一款 DeepSeek Harness 编码插件，响应耗时减少 48%、token 减少 45%，SWE-bench Pro 正确率提升 10%。

description.en: Shows Codex-style ghost next-step prompt suggestions in the composer when an agent finishes a turn, ready to send as-is.
description.zh: 当智能体完成一轮回复时，在输入框中以幽灵文本形式预览可直接发送的下一步提示建议。

description.en: Topic memory for LLM agents: edited topics with question, conclusion, impact, dependencies; local-first, git-traceable, budgeted LLM-free injection.
description.zh: 面向LLM代理的主题记忆：可编辑主题含问题、结论、影响和依赖；本地优先、Git可追溯、预算内免LLM注入。

description.en: Chat-area UX plugin that improves the interaction experience of the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web GUI, with a glassmorphism style.
description.zh: 优化 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）网页界面聊天区交互体验的插件，带玻璃拟态风格。

description.en: macOS computer-use automation with accessibility observations, stale-state rejection, scoped permissions, and safe input.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 macOS 电脑控制：基于 Accessibility 的新鲜观测、拒绝过期状态、作用域权限与安全输入。

description.en: CLI plugin for DSH that makes it easy to set up AI providers like Codex, Claude, OpenCode, OpenRouter and Hermes Agent.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的 CLI 插件，可轻松配置 Codex、Claude、OpenCode、OpenRouter 和 Hermes Agent 等 AI 提供商。

description.en: Adds WorkBuddy China provider to DeepSeek Harness, enabling model calls via API key or account token and managing models in DSH WebUI.
description.zh: 为DeepSeek Harness添加WorkBuddy中国区Provider，通过API密钥或账号令牌调用模型并在WebUI中管理。

description.en: Investment research dashboard for DeepSeek Harness covering memory, AI infrastructure, PCB/CCL and US data-center policy, with MCP market data and updateable research.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的投资研究看板，覆盖存储、AI 基础设施、PCB/CCL 与美国数据中心政策，并接入 MCP 行情数据、支持研究内容更新。

description.en: Searches anime across multiple sources in chat, shows cards with Bangumi ratings and torrent/magnet links.
description.zh: 在对话内多源搜索番剧，以卡片展示 Bangumi 评分与详情，并支持复制磁力链接。

description.en: Gives dsh agents durable Members with persistent memory, notes and skills that survive sessions, rollovers and restarts, coordinating via Channels and Tasks.
description.zh: 为 dsh 智能体提供持久化的成员，拥有跨会话、重启保留的记忆、笔记与技能，并通过频道和任务协作。

description.en: Manages tool and skill exposure in DeepSeek Harness, with on-demand discovery and invocation.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中管理工具与技能的暴露策略，支持按需检索与调用。

description.en: AI agent skill pack for Chinese traditional wisdom (BaZi, Zi Wei, I Ching, Feng Shui, TCM) with local engine and dashboard.
description.zh: 为 AI Agent 提供八字、紫微、六爻、梅花、奇门、风水、五运六气与体质分析的传统智慧技能包，含本地确定性引擎和可视化面板，可用 dsh plugin add 安装。

description.en: Local plain-text double-entry Beancount ledger panel for DSH: the agent drafts entries, you approve or reject, and reconcile balances.
description.zh: DSH 中的本地纯文本复式 Beancount 账本面板：Agent 起草分录，你审批或驳回，并核对余额。

description.en: Cross-session long-term memory for DSH agents: four tools write conclusions to a human-readable NDJSON file and recall them on demand.
description.zh: 为 DSH Agent 提供跨会话长期记忆：四个工具把结论写入人类可读的 NDJSON 文件，并按需显式召回。

description.en: Provides bioinformatics and biology analysis tools for DeepSeek Harness using Biopython for sequence and genomics analysis.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 Biopython 的序列与基因组分析工具，并用 uv+venv 免安装 Python 环境。

description.en: Mines human-microbiome functional dark matter, turning target enzymes/EC/reactions into candidate proteins with sequence, structure and literature evidence.
description.zh: 挖掘人体微生物功能暗物质：把目标酶、EC 号或底物-产物反应转化为候选蛋白，并提供序列、结构与文献证据链及可验证实验方案。

description.en: DSH plugin that keeps AI agents on-task by anchoring good first-round behavior, watching each step, and pulling the agent back when it drifts.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 插件，通过锚定首轮良好行为、逐步监控并在智能体偏离时将其拉回，防止智能体跑偏任务。

description.en: Injects a clarified reading of each user turn into the working AI before it responds, without rewriting the original words, plus a control panel and token stats.
description.zh: 在你发送后、AI 接收前把这一轮的真实意图理清并注入工作 AI 上下文，不改写原话，附带控制界面与真实 token 用量。

description.en: Settings UI for the Roblox Studio MCP bridge that lists connected Studio instances, lets you pick the active one, and shares it with agents as runtime context.
description.zh: Roblox Studio MCP 桥接的设置界面：列出已连接的 Studio 实例，选择当前活动实例，并将其作为运行时上下文提供给智能体。

description.en: DSH plugin porting thincoder self-discipline suite with advisor convergent review, engineering mode, escalation, and consult.
description.zh: 将thincoder自律套件移植到DSH，提供顾问聚合审查、工程模式、升级和咨询功能。

description.en: macOS notch / Windows Fluent dynamic-island overlay showing DeepSeek Harness agent thinking, tool calls, approvals and parallel subagents live.
description.zh: 兼容 macOS 刘海与 Windows Fluent 的灵动岛插件，实时显示 DeepSeek Harness 智能体思考、工具调用、待审批与子代理并行状态。

description.en: Auxiliary models for DeepSeek Harness enabling vision understanding and context compression via dedicated model routes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供辅助模型，通过专用模型路由实现视觉理解与上下文压缩。

description.en: DSH host plugin that lets you control DeepSeek Harness from your phone: approve tool calls, watch streaming output, answer questions, with E2E encryption.
description.zh: DSH 宿主插件：用手机远程操作 DeepSeek Harness，审批工具调用、查看流式输出、回答问题，端到端加密。

description.en: Loads Wallpaper Engine wallpapers as DSH Web GUI backgrounds; renders scene wallpapers via wasm, plays video/web wallpapers.
description.zh: 从本机 Wallpaper Engine 壁纸库加载壁纸作为 DSH Web GUI 背景，用 wasm 渲染 scene 壁纸，并播放视频和 web 壁纸。

description.en: Runs dsh command and tool execution inside rootless Podman containers for isolated, containerized workloads.
description.zh: 在无根 Podman 容器中执行 dsh 的命令与工具调用，实现隔离的容器化运行。

description.en: Kanban task board plugin for the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, with a sidebar entry, five columns, real task execution via DSH sessions, and host-side persistence with cross-device real-time sync.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的任务看板插件，提供侧边栏入口与五列看板，任务通过 DSH 会话真实执行，并在 host 端持久化、跨设备实时同步。

description.en: Hierarchical persistent memory for DSH agents, so they remember preferences and project decisions across sessions without mixing projects.
description.zh: 为 DSH 智能体提供分层持久记忆，跨会话记住偏好与项目决策，并按项目隔离。

description.en: Automated testing platform for DeepSeek Harness with a test-case library, bug reports, per-project serial queues, a dev board, and built-in load testing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自动化测试平台：用例库、缺陷报告、项目串行队列、开发看板与内置压力测试。

description.en: Runtime guard that fails closed to break infinite tool-call and assistant-output loops in DeepSeek Harness agents.
description.zh: 用于DeepSeek Harness的运行时守护，以故障关闭方式中断工具调用和助手输出的无限循环。

description.en: Adds Ollama Cloud as an LLM provider inside DeepSeek Harness (dsh), so the harness can use hosted Ollama models.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness（dsh）添加 Ollama Cloud 作为 LLM 提供方，让 harness 可使用托管的 Ollama 模型。

description.en: DSH plugin that adds a Codex model row, calling the Codex /responses endpoint directly with the local Codex CLI OAuth credentials.
description.zh: DSH 插件，新增 Codex 模型选项，直接调用 Codex /responses 接口并复用本地 Codex CLI 的 OAuth 凭证。

description.en: Agent-driven infinite canvas for DSH that generates images, video and audio on node graphs, with export plus a zero-dependency local MCP bridge, skills and a node plugin market.
description.zh: Agent 驱动的 DSH 无限画布插件，在节点画布上生成图片、视频与音频并导出，内置零依赖本地 MCP 桥、技能系统与节点插件市场。

description.en: HanaMesh MOD-04 app-host DSH plugin that provisions and hosts DSH applications with pinned, SHA256-verified dependencies.
description.zh: HanaMesh MOD-04 应用宿主 DSH 插件，按固定版本并经 SHA256 校验的依赖置备并托管 DSH 应用。

description.en: Monorepo plugin family for the DSH Web GUI with a plugin template, dev kit and one-command all-in-one bundle of extra tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web GUI 的插件家族单体仓库，提供插件模板、开发工具包和一键式全家桶安装包。

description.en: Floating capsule in DSH showing GLM Coding Plan and GitHub Copilot quota snapshots and subscription usage details.
description.zh: DSH 悬浮胶囊插件，直观展示 GLM Coding Plan 与 GitHub Copilot 的额度快照和订阅用量详情。

description.en: In-page task notifications for DeepSeek Harness with toasts, bell history, WebAudio cue, and flashing tab title.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供页面内任务通知：弹窗提示、铃铛历史、WebAudio 提示音和标签页标题闪烁。

description.en: Orchestrates a multi-agent OpenSpec implementation pipeline with dev, review and quality-check stages run in an isolated worktree.
description.zh: 为 OpenSpec 实施阶段编排多 Agent 流水线，开发与审核分工，隔离 worktree 中推进并强制质量审查。

description.en: Manage skills (SKILL.md) and MCP servers from one DSH settings panel with global/project-level layering and instant apply.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中管理技能（SKILL.md）和 MCP 服务器，支持全局/项目级分层，修改后立即生效。

description.en: Toggle each agent skill on, user-only, or off from the composer and Settings, updating SKILL.md invocation fields.
description.zh: 在输入框弹层与设置页中，将每个 agent 技能切换为开启、仅用户可用或关闭，并写入 SKILL.md 调用字段。

description.en: Compresses bash/PowerShell output with the local rtk CLI before it reaches the model, plus a settings card reporting token savings.
description.zh: 在输出到达模型前，使用本地 rtk CLI 压缩 bash/PowerShell 命令输出，并提供显示节省量的设置卡片。

description.en: Packs external Agent CLIs, persistent terminals, workspace debugging and remote access into the DSH native interface.
description.zh: 把外部 Agent CLI、持久终端、工作区调试和远程访问集成进 DSH 原生界面。

description.en: Godot 4 production pack for DSH with runnable 2D templates, a deterministic scene/script validator, and one-command Web export.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 Godot 4 生产工具包，提供可运行的 2D 模板、确定性的场景/脚本校验器以及一键 Web 导出。

description.en: Observe and steer a local OpenAI Codex session from DeepSeek Harness over the Codex app-server JSON-RPC protocol.
description.zh: 通过 Codex app-server 协议，在 DeepSeek Harness 中观察并操控本地 OpenAI Codex 会话。

description.en: A heartbeat plugin that lets the DSH agent wake on a rhythm, keep memory and user profiles, and decide when to speak up.
description.zh: 心跳插件：让 DSH agent 按节律醒来，维护记忆与画像，并按分寸决定是否开口。

description.en: Local HTTP API letting other agents control DeepSeek Harness sessions via official ApiProxy routes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供本地 HTTP API，让其他智能体通过官方 ApiProxy 路由控制 DSH 会话。

description.en: Prompt-routed subagent delegation from DeepSeek Harness to DSH, Codex, Kimi Code and Antigravity (agy) agents.
description.zh: 通过提示词路由，将 DeepSeek Harness 的任务委派给 DSH、Codex、Kimi Code 和 Antigravity（agy）子代理。

description.en: Selection-scoped explanation sidebar that forks isolated citation threads from DeepSeek Harness conversations for focused Q&A.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 对话中选中文本后，从该对话分叉出独立引用线程，在侧栏内做聚焦问答。

description.en: DSH multi-threaded download plugin with built-in aria2 that auto-detects file size to pick the best download strategy across platforms.
description.zh: DSH 多线程下载插件，内置 aria2，自动探测文件大小以选择最佳下载策略，支持多平台。

description.en: A resident AI commander plugin for DeepSeek Harness that makes routine decisions for you and delegates work through tiered automation levels.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的常驻 AI 指挥员插件，替你做常规决策，并通过分级方式托管不同层级的自动化任务。

description.en: Enables multi-agent team collaboration with independent models, skills, MCP tools, and a shared workspace.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多智能体团队协作，各智能体可独立配置模型、技能、MCP 工具与上下文，并共用同一工作区。

description.en: Local Git workbench plus GitHub Code/Issues/PRs/Actions tabs inside the DSH right sidebar, with commit messages written by your DSH model.
description.zh: 把本地 Git 工作台和 GitHub 的 Code/Issues/PR/Actions 页签装进 DSH 右侧栏，提交信息由 DSH 模型生成。

description.en: Adds collapsible manual virtual groups to the DSH sidebar workspace list, changing only display grouping and order.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧边栏工作区列表添加可折叠的手动虚拟分组，只改变显示归属与顺序。

description.en: Adds four tools that let separate DSH sessions message each other, hand off tasks, reply back, and check progress, including auto-waking a closed session.
description.zh: 提供四个工具，让不同 DSH 会话之间互发消息、交接任务、回信并查看进度，还能自动唤醒已关闭的会话。

description.en: In-app DSH Desktop update center with progress bar, resume, auto-replace the app and restart, plus skills/MCP/agent settings pages.
description.zh: 内置 DSH Desktop 更新中心：带进度条、断点续传、自动替换应用并重启，并新增技能、MCP、智能体与导入设置页。

description.en: Private out-of-tree runtime bridge integrating DeepSeek Harness with Multica via JSONL over stdio.
description.zh: 通过标准输入输出上的 JSONL 将 DeepSeek Harness 与 Multica 集成的私有外部运行时桥接，为 Multica 提供 dsh 运行时支持。

description.en: A sidebar credential vault for DeepSeek Harness that stores accounts, passwords and API keys behind an access lock, with an agent read tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边栏凭据保险库，安全保存账号、密码和 API 密钥，带访问锁与智能体读取工具。

description.en: Decentralized agent network plugin for DSH: publish agent cards, discover peers, resolve names, route with failover.
description.zh: DSH 的去中心化智能体网络插件，用于发布智能体卡片、发现对等节点、解析名称，并在路由时支持故障转移。

description.en: A 3D hardware sandbox for DSH: assemble parts, wire them up, and run your project's own code against virtual hardware.
description.zh: DSH 的 3D 硬件沙盒：装配元件、接线，并在虚拟硬件上运行你自己的项目代码。

description.en: Continuously logs your local Harness LLM calls — prompts, skills, tool calls, file I/O and web fetches — into readable Markdown per session.
description.zh: 持续记录本地 Harness 调用 LLM 的全过程：提示词、技能加载、工具调用、文件读写与联网抓取，按会话生成易读的 Markdown 报告。

description.en: Local cross-platform content recommendation agent plugin for DeepSeek Harness, with UI tab and Agent Bridge tools.
description.zh: 本地跨平台个性化内容推荐 Agent 的 DSH 插件，在界面加第四栏并提供 22 个 Agent Bridge 工具。

description.en: OpenMAIC plugin for DeepSeek Harness enabling classrooms, slides, interactive widgets, and Socratic teaching.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenMAIC，提供课堂、幻灯片、交互式组件和苏格拉底式教学功能。

description.en: Community dsh suite: OpenVulcan account, Vulcan Decision permission guard, interactive answers, VulcanCode UI style, and LuaSkills Hub.
description.zh: 面向 dsh 的社区 VulcanCode 插件套件，包含 OpenVulcan 账户、Vulcan Decision 权限守卫、交互式回答、VulcanCode UI 样式及 LuaSkills Hub。

description.en: oh-my-zsh-style enhancement bundle for DeepSeek Harness: packaged skills, work-rule prompts, Enhance agent preset, guards, work tracking and worktrees.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的 oh-my-zsh 风格增强包：内置技能、工作规则提示、Enhance 智能体预设、守卫与交付门禁、工作跟踪与 worktree。

description.en: Read-only MCP server exposing DSH plugin certification registry with grades, snapshot dates, and five-dimension evidence.
description.zh: 只读 MCP 服务器，公开 DSH 插件认证注册库，含等级、快照日期和五维证据。

description.en: Zero-dependency static and sandbox smoke detector that verifies and lints DeepSeek Harness plugins across R/K/D/CC layers.
description.zh: 零依赖的静态与沙箱冒烟检测器，按 R/K/D/CC 分层校验和检查 DeepSeek Harness 插件。

description.en: Windows desktop pet driven by DeepSeek Harness agent status, showing account balance, desktop-bubble Q&A and 53 joke lines.
description.zh: 由 DeepSeek Harness 工作状态驱动的 Windows 桌面宠物，支持余额显示、桌面气泡问答和 53 条玩梗留言。

description.en: Russian (ru) language pack that localizes the DeepSeek Harness web GUI, installed as a hybrid dsh.bundle + dsh.client plugin.
description.zh: 俄语（ru）语言包，为 DeepSeek Harness Web 界面提供本地化，以 dsh.bundle + dsh.client 混合插件形式安装。

description.en: DSH test assistant that narrows manual test scope from Git diffs, records web/mobile operation tracks and crash logs, and uses AI to generate reproducible bug steps.
description.zh: 基于 Git 差异缩减手工测试范围，录制 Web/移动端操作轨迹与崩溃日志，并用 AI 生成可复现缺陷步骤的 DSH 测试助手插件。

description.en: Provides A2A (agent-to-agent) services and a connection dashboard for DeepSeek Harness plugins.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 插件提供 A2A（智能体间）服务与连接面板。

description.en: Search saved conversation titles and messages across DSH workspaces, plus Ctrl+F / Cmd+F find-in-page inside the current chat.
description.zh: 跨 DSH 工作区搜索已保存的对话标题与消息，并支持在当前聊天内使用 Ctrl+F / Cmd+F 页内查找。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration layer for DeepSeek Harness with 42 skills, 33 role cards, 55 MCP tools, graph DAG runtime, team pipelines and a HUD panel.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的多智能体编排层，内置 42 个技能、33 张角色卡、55 个 MCP 工具、图 DAG 运行时、团队流水线与 HUD 面板。

description.en: Manage multiple OpenAI-compatible image generation configs and create or edit images directly inside the DSH conversation.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理多套 OpenAI 兼容的生图配置，并在对话里直接文生图或按参考图编辑出图。

description.en: Embeds a persistent stock index bar and draggable quote window in the DSH chat UI, showing real-time quotes, charts and holding P&L.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面嵌入常驻大盘指数栏与可拖动行情悬浮窗，实时显示行情、分时/K线与持仓盈亏。

description.en: Brings WorkBuddy (global & China) models into DeepSeek Harness via one settings card with separate providers, credentials and live model catalog.
description.zh: 将 WorkBuddy 国际版/国内版模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，用一张设置卡片分别管理两套 provider、凭证与实时模型目录。

description.en: DSH usage statistics dashboard with token, cost, duration, session aggregation and visualizations.
description.zh: DSH 用量统计面板插件，按 token、费用、时长和会话聚合数据，并提供趋势、热力图和日历视图。

description.en: Workspace-aware direnv support that injects each workspace's .envrc environment into every agent-owned shell command.
description.zh: 工作区感知的 direnv 支持，自动把所在工作区的 .envrc 环境注入每个 agent 拥有的 shell 命令。

description.en: Japanese language plugin that translates the DSH Web UI into Japanese with friendly fallback fonts.
description.zh: 将 DSH 网页界面翻译为日语的本地化插件，并提供友好的日文回退字体。

description.en: Schedules cron jobs that run shell commands and wake an agent only when a gate condition asks for it.
description.zh: 定时运行 shell 命令的 cron 任务插件，仅在门控条件触发时才唤醒智能体。

description.en: Injects a prompt library button into the composer toolbar to manage reusable snippets and auto-learn from complex inputs.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 的 composer 工具栏注入提示词库按钮，管理可复用 prompt 片段，点击插入输入框，并自动识别保存复杂输入。

description.en: Unofficial Simplified-Chinese fork of a tri-agent preset pairing Atlas orchestration with Prometheus planning, packaged for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 非官方简体中文分叉的三智能体预设，结合 Atlas 编排与 Prometheus 规划，打包用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: DSH plugin that gives DeepSeek Harness agents Cheat Engine tools for memory scanning, pointer analysis, breakpoints and dynamic debugging.
description.zh: DSH 插件为 DeepSeek Harness 智能体提供 Cheat Engine 工具，支持内存扫描、指针分析、断点与动态调试。

description.en: Uses your Claude Code (Claude Pro/Max) sign-in as a DSH model provider, keeping the pi-ai credential synced with the Claude Code keychain.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code(Claude Pro/Max)的登录凭据用作 DSH 模型提供方,并让 pi-ai 凭据与 Claude Code 钥匙串保持同步。

description.en: DSH plugin that forks the session when you type while the agent is busy, answering new commands instantly and injecting the old turn's result back later.
description.zh: DSH 插件：agent 忙时自动分叉会话，你的新指令立刻在新会话中响应，旧会话在后台跑完后把结果回注回来。

description.en: Process-level outbound proxy for DSH based on a local mihomo kernel, with SSRF protection, kernel SHA256 verification and subscription credential masking.
description.zh: 基于本地 mihomo 内核的 DSH 进程级出站代理插件，具备 SSRF 防护、内核 SHA256 校验与订阅凭据脱敏。

description.en: Audits DSH disk usage across sessions, attachments and caches, then moves reclaimable files into a restorable quarantine instead of deleting them.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 的会话、附件与缓存占用，并把可清理文件移入可还原的隔离区而非直接删除。

description.en: DSH plugin that lists local TCP listening ports with their owning processes and safely kills them after re-verifying process identity to avoid PID-reuse mistakes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：列出本机 TCP 监听端口及占用进程，结束前复核进程身份，避免误杀被复用的 PID。

description.en: Multi-round iterative deep-research plugin that searches 14 platforms, grades source credibility A/B/C/D, cross-verifies claims and flags misinformation.
description.zh: 多轮迭代深度检索插件，覆盖14个平台定向搜索，按A/B/C/D分级来源可信度，交叉验证并识别虚假信息。

description.en: Provides a terminal-based user interface mode for DeepSeek Harness, built on a vendored fork of pi-tui.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于 pi-tui 内置分支构建的第三方终端界面模式

description.en: Star DSH sessions and workspaces, filter to favourites only, hide the rest, pin with hover metadata, and inherit stars through forks.
description.zh: 收藏 DSH 会话与工作区，仅显示收藏、隐藏未收藏项，支持悬停元数据固定、星标颜色与分支继承。

description.en: Routes all DSH runtime traffic (model requests, web search/fetch, spawned tools) through the Windows system proxy or a custom address, with a one-click header toggle.
description.zh: 将 DSH 全部运行时流量（模型请求、web search/fetch、spawned 工具）统一路由到 Windows 系统代理或自定义地址，并支持对话头部一键切换。

description.en: Manages SSH hosts in DSH, opens remote terminals, browses/edits remote files and Git, and mounts remote dirs as workspaces so agent ops run remotely.
description.zh: 在 DSH 中管理 SSH 主机,打开远程终端,浏览与编辑远程文件和 Git,并把远程目录设为工作区,让 Agent 的操作在远端执行。

description.en: Connects external Agent Client Protocol (ACP) agents to DeepSeek Harness (DSH) via an adapter plugin.
description.zh: 将外部 Agent Client Protocol 代理通过适配器插件接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Augments the DSH Web shell with a Running & recent panel, activity buckets and session artifacts so you see the working session, not just the answer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面增加「运行中与最近」面板、活动分组和会话产物视图，让你看到工作过程而非只有答案。

description.en: Read-only ledger that inventories installed DSH plugins with file:line evidence, version drift and changes since the last scan.
description.zh: 只读清单插件，盘点已安装的 DSH 插件，提供 file:line 证据、版本漂移与上次扫描后的变更对比。

description.en: Sends a Windows native notification when a DSH task truly finishes, showing session title, result status and last reply summary.
description.zh: 当 DSH 任务真正完成时，在 Windows 通知栏弹出原生通知，显示会话标题、结果状态与最后一条回复摘要。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness dispatch-mode agent preset and agent-team plugin with 12 teammate roles, shared cache-friendly cards, and structured result reporting.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的调度模式智能体预设与团队插件，提供 12 类队员角色、共享队员卡与结构化汇报能力。

description.en: Shows your active Codex, Claude Code, OpenCode, Pi, or DeepSeek Harness work as Discord Rich Presence via one local service.
description.zh: 通过一个本地服务，将 Codex、Claude Code、OpenCode、Pi 或 DeepSeek Harness 的当前工作状态显示为 Discord Rich Presence。

description.en: Live, zoomable map showing each model call, its response, and which subagent gets dispatched in DeepSeek Harness sessions.
description.zh: 实时可缩放地图，展示 DeepSeek Harness 会话中的每次模型调用、返回结果及分派的子代理。

description.en: AstrBot plugin that forwards selected IM conversations to a local DeepSeek Harness agent, requiring dsh-astrbot-ingress.
description.zh: AstrBot 插件，将选定的即时通讯会话转发给本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体，需配合 dsh-astrbot-ingress。

description.en: AI-driven partial-wave analysis automation: edits physics configs, runs ctpwa fits, evaluates results, iterates to convergence.
description.zh: AI驱动的分波分析自动化：编辑物理配置，运行ctpwa拟合，评估数值结果并迭代收敛。

description.en: AI-native knowledge base for 3D Gaussian Splatting: 900 arXiv-verified methods, 15 agent skills, and an MCP server with 34 tools.
description.zh: 面向 3D 高斯泼溅的 AI 原生知识库：收录 900 篇 arXiv 验证方法、15 个智能体技能，并提供含 34 个工具的 MCP 服务器。

description.en: BrewReel turns a product brief into a polished vertical promo video: AI picks shots and writes copy, then one command renders it with cheap LLMs like DeepSeek.
description.zh: BrewReel 用 DeepSeek 等低价模型，把产品简报一键生成竖版宣传片：AI 挑镜头、写文案，一条命令出片。

description.en: Local image-generation workbench with canvas layout, retouching, erase, background removal, OCR, vectorizing and editable PSD/AI export plus PS/AI layer bridging.
description.zh: 本地生图工作台:自带 API 生图,支持画布排版、修图擦除、去背景、OCR、转矢量,并可导出可编辑 PSD/AI 及图层级双向桥接。

description.en: MCP server for AI assistants to search CNKI and read article metadata.
description.zh: 为AI助手提供检索知网文章及读取元数据的MCP服务器。

description.en: Local MCP bridge that lets Codex dispatch implementation tasks to native DeepSeek Harness sessions and read results in the same chat.
description.zh: 本地 MCP 桥接插件，让 Codex 把实现任务派发给 DSH 原生会话并在同一对话中取回结果。

description.en: AI coding coach preset for non-developers, guiding idea-to-launch via an eight-stage pipeline.
description.zh: 面向非开发者的 AI 编程教练预设，通过八个阶段的流程引导从想法到上线。

description.en: Runtime-agnostic Rust port of Cordis plugin framework with DI, lifecycle effects, events, and logging.
description.zh: Cordis 插件框架的 Rust 移植，运行时无关，提供作用域依赖注入、生命周期效应管理、事件与结构化日志，无第三方依赖。

description.en: Ocean-themed blue whale UI plugin with fish, bubbles, mascot, and brand replacement for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供海洋蓝鲸主题界面，包含海洋配色、鱼群、气泡、吉祥物，并替换品牌元素。

description.en: Community Docker and Kubernetes packaging for DeepSeek Harness with hardened image, Compose stack, Helm chart, Web UI, and headless CLI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供社区版 Docker 与 Kubernetes 打包，包括加固镜像、Compose 编排、Helm chart、Web 界面和无头 CLI。

description.en: Imports chat.deepseek.com web conversation history into DeepSeek Harness as sessions, allowing continuation.
description.zh: 将 chat.deepseek.com 的网页对话历史导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为会话，以便继续对话。

description.en: Portable all-in-one launcher for DeepSeek Harness, double-click to run without installing.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 绿色便携整合启动器，双击即可运行，所有文件集中在一个文件夹内，不写入 C 盘、无需安装。

description.en: DSH Desktop plugin that replaces the Windows window title bar with an in-app bar carrying New Session and Session History actions.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 插件，用应用配色重绘 Windows 窗口标题栏，并加入新建会话与会话历史按钮。

description.en: A DingTalk digital-employee plugin integrating group chat with DeepSeek Harness for persistent AI agents.
description.zh: 基于DeepSeek Harness的钉钉群聊常驻数字员工插件，实现多Agent协作与任务自动化。

description.en: Extensible quick-control panel for DSH Web offering registry switching and a skin manager, usable standalone or with dock-base.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的可扩展快捷控制面板，支持切换注册表与皮肤管理，可独立使用或配合 dock-base。

description.en: Ports Claude Code's Academic Research Skills (ARS) to DSH, adding deep research, paper writing, peer review, and pipeline skills.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的学术研究技能移植到 DSH，提供深度研究、论文写作、同行评审和流水线技能。

description.en: Temporary fix for DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL sandbox failures on non-system-drive workspaces, restoring workspace-write without changing system ACLs.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.7 Windows ACL 沙箱在非系统盘工作区失败的临时修复，无需改动系统 ACL 即可恢复 workspace-write。

description.en: Delegates tasks asynchronously to external ACP agents like Codex, Claude Code and Gemini, with live child-session streaming and token accounting.
description.zh: 将任务异步委派给 Codex、Claude Code、Gemini 等外部 ACP 智能体,支持子会话实时流式输出与 token 统计。

description.en: Adds an activity pane to DSH showing running, sub, awaiting-response, and recently active sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 添加活动面板，显示运行中、子会话、等待响应以及最近活跃的会话。

description.en: Adds a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects insight/notes into the conversation.
description.zh: Advisor - Pair a second model that passively reviews each turn and injects notes.  搭配一个会在每轮对话被动注入见解和审查的副模型。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing an on-demand executor/advisor workflow with ask_advisor, review gates, usage ledger, and privacy tiers.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供按需的执行者/顾问工作流，包含 ask_advisor、审查关卡、用量账本和隐私层级。

description.en: Agent bridge plugin for DeepSeek Harness using JSON recipes, a cross-platform launcher, recipe wizard, self-test and registry import.
description.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的智能体桥接插件，支持 JSON 配方、跨平台启动器、配方向导、自检与注册表导入。

description.en: Connects Super Agent group chat and discussion into dsh via a cordis plugin with 5 agent tools, an agent-chat skill and a reusable workbench UI over the /wb channel.
description.zh: 通过 cordis 插件把 Super Agent 群聊与讨论接入 dsh，提供 5 个 agent 工具、agent-chat 技能，并经 /wb 通道复用完整工作台界面。

description.en: DSH plugin that deletes a session or a single turn through one shared confirmation flow and a consistent set of failure codes.
description.zh: DSH 插件：通过统一的确认流程和一致的失败码，删除整个会话或单轮对话。

description.en: Cross-session agent communication plugin for DeepSeek Harness: lets agent sessions message each other.
description.zh: 跨会话 Agent 通信插件，让同一进程内不同 Agent 会话之间互相收发消息。

description.en: Manages workspace personas for DSH: multiple system-prompt presets, each scoped by workspace path or session id and edited from Web settings.
description.zh: 为 DSH 管理工作区人格：多个系统提示词预设，按工作区路径或会话 ID 隔离，可在 Web 设置页配置。

description.en: Adds a "hard-task model" suggestion layer so the main session can pick stronger whitelisted models for DSH native subagents based on task difficulty.
description.zh: 为主会话选择 DSH 原生子智能体模型时增加「困难任务模型」建议，可按任务难度为子智能体选用更合适的白名单模型。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness, defining a captain plus members with their own prompt, model, reasoning effort, and tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可复用的 Agent Team 预设，包含队长与成员各自的提示词、模型、推理强度和工具配置。

description.en: Agent-native multi-provider web search with model grounding and semantic search, exposed via MCP, CLI, and a DSH plugin.
description.zh: 面向 AI Agent 的多供应商网页搜索，支持模型接地与语义搜索，可通过 MCP、CLI 和 DSH 插件使用。

description.en: Native scene-based agents for DeepSeek Harness with bilingual management, explicit model policy and scoped tool access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供原生场景智能体，具备双语管理、显式模型策略与受限工具权限。

description.en: DSH plugin that subscribes to the session event stream and appends one diary entry per settled turn into a git repo you own.
description.zh: DSH 插件订阅会话事件流，将每个完成回合追加为一条日记条目，写入属于你自己的 git 仓库。

description.en: Adds a settings-panel editor for the global /.dsh/AGENTS.md rules file with auto-backups, conflict detection and one-click restore.
description.zh: 在设置面板中新增全局规则 /.dsh/AGENTS.md 编辑器，支持自动备份、冲突检测与一键恢复。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin that turns agent modes into full presets, each with its own persona, tool set and plugin mounts, shipping six ready-made modes.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，将代理模式变成完整预设，每种模式自带人格、工具集和插件挂载，并内置六种模式。

description.en: View, search and edit all workspace and global AGENTS.md files in one panel, with templates, batch preview and AI edit suggestions.
description.zh: 在一个面板中查看、搜索和编辑工作区及全局 AGENTS.md，支持模板、批量预览和 AI 修改建议。

description.en: Self-evolving agent framework for DSH with 40 Cordis plugins, 4 presets, memory, reflection, gates, metrics, and an auditable evolution loop.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的自进化智能体框架，包含 40 个 Cordis 插件、4 个预设、记忆、反思、门控、指标与可审计进化循环。

description.en: Adds Google Antigravity (agy) OAuth login and model access to DSH with a multi-account pool, 429 rotation and device fingerprinting.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 Google Antigravity (agy) 的 OAuth 登录与模型访问，支持多账号池、429 限流轮换与设备指纹。

description.en: Layered project memory for DeepSeek Harness with process logs, archives, snapshots, context cleanup/restore, knowledge search and risk-reviewed decisions.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的分层项目记忆插件，包含过程日志、归档、快照、上下文清理与恢复、知识检索和风险评审决策。

description.en: Admission gate for every model call in DSH, enforcing session/day/month cost caps with alert, block or degrade actions and a /gateway control surface.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的每次模型调用提供统一准入网关，按会话/日/月限制成本，支持告警、阻断或降级，并提供 /gateway 控制面板。

description.en: DSH plugin that turns a workspace into a live visual-novel stage, rendering Stage DSL with backgrounds, sprites, dialog, choices and line-by-line TTS.
description.zh: DSH 插件把工作区变成实时视觉小说舞台，渲染 Stage DSL，包含背景、立绘、对话、停点选择与逐行 TTS。

description.en: Usage dashboard for DeepSeek Harness showing token/cache analytics, model/provider/workspace breakdown, DeepSeek balance, heatmap, and CSV export.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板，提供 token/缓存分析、模型/供应商/工作区统计、余额、热力图和 CSV 导出。

description.en: Replaces DeepSeek Harness web UI fonts with Anthropic fonts, including Chinese fallbacks; fonts not bundled.
description.zh: 用 Anthropic 字体替换 DeepSeek Harness 网页界面字体，并包含中文回退字体，字体本身不随插件打包。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin providing Antigravity OAuth login and native Auth capability bundle.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Antigravity OAuth 登录及原生 Antigravity Auth 能力包。

description.en: Generates verifiable architecture, workflow, sequence, dataflow, and lifecycle diagrams from JSON specs, outputting standalone HTML.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：用 JSON 规格生成可验证的架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图与生命周期图（移植自 tt-a1i/archify）

description.en: Validates an archive filing register: required fields, unique archive numbers, gap-free item numbers, retention terms, dates and transfer deadlines.
description.zh: 核对归档登记表：检查必填字段、档号唯一性、件号连续性、保管期限用语、形成日期与年度匹配及超期移交，仅提示差异。

description.en: Static Python architecture maps with drill-down from project to flow, module and method, exported as offline single-file HTML.
description.zh: 静态 Python 架构图，可从项目逐层下钻到流程、模块和方法，并导出为离线单文件 HTML。

description.en: Arknights theme pack for DSH Web GUI with wallpapers, saturation-driven edge blur, an acrylic sidebar, and a one-click wallpaper picker.
description.zh: 明日方舟主题包，为 DSH 网页界面提供壁纸、饱和度边缘模糊、亚克力侧边栏和一键壁纸选择器。

description.en: Adds a sidebar artifact manager to browse, search, preview and manage DSH-generated files across directories with card/list views.
description.zh: 在左侧栏新增产物管家，可跨目录浏览、搜索、预览并管理 DSH 生成的文件，支持卡片/列表双视图。

description.en: Adds OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/transcriptions endpoints to DSH so any OpenAI client can use its local SenseVoice speech-to-text model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 补出 OpenAI 兼容的 /v1/audio/transcriptions 接口，让任意 OpenAI 客户端调用内置 SenseVoice 语转文模型。

description.en: Multi-machine DSH workbench: switch local/remote devices, cross-device Todo, 1–9 model quick-switch, mobile drawer and local Codex agent control.
description.zh: 多机 DSH 工作台：本机/远程设备切换、跨设备待办、1–9 模型快捷切换、移动端抽屉与本机 Codex Agent 控制入口。

description.en: Persistent memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness with topic organization, undoable merges, native reminders, Markdown storage, import/export and backups.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供持久记忆的插件，支持主题整理、可撤销合并、原生提醒、Markdown 本地存储、导入导出与备份恢复。

description.en: DSH plugin that uses a decision model to analyze each request and auto-route it to the best-fitting model across multiple providers, with quota cooldown and silent fallback.
description.zh: DSH 插件：用决策模型分析每次请求，自动路由到最合适的模型，支持多厂商、额度冷却与静默回退。

description.en: Queues your composer draft and sends it automatically at a scheduled later time, such as off-peak cheap hours at 12:00 or 18:00.
description.zh: 将输入框草稿加入队列，在预约的稍后时间（如 12:00 / 18:00 错峰时段）自动发送。

description.en: Adds wake rules to any DSH session: the host periodically checks whether a turn ended abnormally and re-prompts the session to keep working.
description.zh: 给任意 DSH 会话挂唤醒规则：宿主定期检查该轮是否异常结束，命中条件就重新 prompt 让它继续干活。

description.en: Safe auto-approval for DeepSeek Harness using deterministic rules and LLM review without ever granting full access.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供自动审批：在 workspace-write 沙箱上叠加确定性规则和 LLM 审查，自动模式不放宽沙箱权限。

description.en: Routes DeepSeek Harness requests to strong or cheap model tiers with intent gating, plan handoff, risk guards, and failure escalation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 请求自动选择强模型或廉价模型层级，支持意图判断、计划交接、风险防护与失败升级。

description.en: AWiki identity and messaging plugin with Web UI, draggable launcher, and attachment support.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 AWiki 身份与消息收发功能，含 Web 界面、可拖动启动器和附件支持。

description.en: Backs up DSH skills, plugins, config, memory and todos into one tar.gz and restores them per-module on a new machine via baseline three-way merge.
description.zh: 把 DSH 的技能、插件、配置、记忆和待办打包成 tar.gz，换机时按模块基于基线做三方合并导入。

description.en: Adds native, goal and handoff compaction modes to DeepSeek Harness, with token-budget controls and visualisation of the compaction process.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 native、goal、handoff 三种压缩模式，并带有预算控制与可视化。

description.en: Hash-anchored read, edit and undo_last_edit tools for DeepSeek Harness that cut token usage and cost.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供基于哈希锚点的读取、编辑与撤销上次编辑工具，降低 token 消耗与成本。

description.en: Renders streaming Markdown in the DSH Web UI with Mermaid diagrams, KaTeX math, and a safe fallback renderer.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面提供流式 Markdown 渲染，支持 Mermaid 图表、KaTeX 数学公式和安全回退渲染器。

description.en: Pre-checks a bid compliance register against tender requirements with versioned rule packs, flagging only differences without conclusions.
description.zh: 依据版本化规则包预检投标符合性响应台账与招标要求的差异,仅提示差异,不作定性结论。

description.en: A jar widget in the corner that searches Bilibili along your own interest axes, ranks by engagement rate, and lets an LLM curate five videos with reasons.
description.zh: 右下角罐子插件：按你自定义的兴趣轴搜B站，按互动率排序，再由大模型挑出5条并各写一句理由。

description.en: Blender plugin for 3D modeling, reconstruction, rendering, validation, and export workflows.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的 Blender 插件，用于完成三维建模、重建、渲染、校验与导出流程。

description.en: A DeepSeek Harness Web theme plugin offering 10 OKLCH Morandi color schemes plus optional frosted-glass wallpaper overlay.
description.zh: 一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 主题插件：提供十套 OKLCH 莫兰迪配色，并可选壁纸加磨砂玻璃叠加效果。

description.en: Enhanced full-frame boot intro animation for DSH with playback control, trigger rules, session lists, time-based intros and splash library management.
description.zh: DSH 片头开机动画增强版，支持播放控制、触发规则、会话名单、分时段片头与片库管理，中英双语。

description.en: A BornCode plugin bundle for DSH adding agent customization, desktop control, browser use, session sync, auto-continue/shutdown and side chat.
description.zh: 一个 BornCode 插件合集，为 DSH 提供代理定制、桌面控制、浏览器使用、会话同步、自动继续/关机和侧边聊天。

description.en: Jailbreak plugin that injects prompts and patches DSH host source (72 local edits) with backup and one-click rollback.
description.zh: 越狱类插件：注入提示词并打补丁改写 DSH 宿主源码（本机结算 72 项改动），每条改动均有备份且可一键回滚。

description.en: DSH client plugin that connects to a local Breeze TTS service so the AI can speak aloud offline and clone voices, keeping data on-device.
description.zh: DSH 本地语音插件，连接自建的 Breeze TTS 服务，让 AI 离线开口朗读并克隆声音，数据不出本机。

description.en: Collects each machine's dsh bridge public tunnel address into one secret Gist and refreshes online status every 4 hours.
description.zh: 把每台机器 dsh bridge 的公网隧道地址汇总到一个 secret Gist，每 4 小时整点刷新在线状态。

description.en: Meters token and cost usage per model, session and day, enforces budget caps with threshold alerts, and adds carbon and latency insights.
description.zh: 按模型、会话和日期统计 token 与费用，支持预算上限与阈值告警，并提供碳足迹估算和延迟基准。

description.en: Enables DeepSeek Harness to directly control local Abaqus/CAE via 21 native tools covering the full FEA modeling chain.
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 通过 21 个原生工具直接操控本机 Abaqus/CAE，覆盖几何、材料、网格、接触、分析步、载荷、边界、作业与 ODB 的完整建模链，经 socket 桥接直连，不走 MCP。

description.en: Adds a composer toolbar menu that turns individual tools and skills on or off per session, grouped by plugin.
description.zh: 在输入框工具栏提供按插件分组的开关，可为每个会话单独开启或关闭各个工具与技能。

description.en: Adds an explore-style card tree to the DSH Web UI so conversation branches grow into an editable graph with one-way references.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web UI 加入探索式卡片树，让对话分支长成可编辑的图谱，并支持单向引用。

description.en: A DSH Web UI decoration plugin that fires emoji confetti and a spinning disco mirror ball when the agent is told to celebrate.
description.zh: 一个 DSH Web UI 装饰插件，让智能体「放礼炮」时屏幕喷出 emoji 彩纸，并降下旋转的迪斯科镜面球。

description.en: Mobile-friendly DSH chat panel with its own searchable history library, image/PDF/Office attachments and an installable PWA page.
description.zh: 手机友好的 DSH 闲聊面板，自带可搜索的自管历史库，支持图片/PDF/Office 附件，并可安装为 PWA 独立网页应用。

description.en: Ports DeepSeek's official web right-side chat navigation rail (ScrollNav) as a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin.
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek 官方网页版右侧聊天导航栏（ScrollNav）1:1 移植为 DeepSeek Harness 插件

description.en: Cited for DeepSeek Harness searches your documents and answers questions with inline citations via RAG.
description.zh: Cited 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供文档检索，并基于 RAG 给出带引用的回答。

description.en: Migrate Claude Code sessions, memory, skills, and CLAUDE.md into DSH for seamless resume.
description.zh: 将 Claude Code 的会话、记忆、技能和 CLAUDE.md 迁移到 DSH，支持无缝恢复，提供 claude_scan、import_claude、resume-claude 命令和网页面板。

description.en: Sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness that dispatches named CLI agents with chosen CLI, model and role, then tracks and resumes their tasks.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多 CLI 智能体侧栏插件：可选择 CLI、模型与角色派出智能体，查看过程并续聊同一任务。

description.en: Connects CNB (cnb.cool) to DeepSeek Harness: QR-code login, repo management, cloud dev environments, org usage and gateway model routing.
description.zh: 将 CNB（cnb.cool）接入 DeepSeek Harness：扫码登录、仓库管理、云原生开发环境、组织用量与网关模型路由。

description.en: A Cursor-style AI code editor plugin for DSH with file tree, multi-tab editing, syntax highlighting, and an embedded AI input box.
description.zh: 适用于 DSH 的 Cursor 风格 AI 代码编辑器插件，提供文件树、多标签编辑、语法高亮和内嵌 AI 输入框。

description.en: Bridges Codebase Memory MCP code knowledge graph into DSH via official DSH MCP client.
description.zh: 通过官方 DSH MCP 客户端把 Codebase Memory MCP 的代码知识图谱接入 DSH。

description.en: A Codex-like WYSIWYG Markdown editor in the DSH right sidebar that renders documents you edit in place, including table cells.
description.zh: DSH 右侧边栏的类 Codex Markdown 编辑器，文档直接渲染并可就地编辑，包括表格单元格。

description.en: Windows desktop computer-use plugin for DeepSeek Harness with 18 computer_* tools, Set-of-Marks grounding, approval modes, JSONL audit, and a human brake.
description.zh: Windows 桌面计算机使用插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 18 个 computer_* 工具、Set-of-Marks 定位、审批模式、JSONL 审计和人工刹车。

description.en: A DSH coding-agent runtime that orchestrates tasks with a Pro planner and Flash sub-agents across Codex's five-stage contract.
description.zh: 一个 DSH 编程智能体运行时插件，用 Pro 分析需求编排任务、Flash 子智能体执行，并按五段式契约层层推进。

description.en: Adds a user-editable reporting layer so you choose which DSH agents and subagents report to whom, on top of the fixed native tree.
description.zh: 新增用户可编辑的汇报层级，让你自行决定 DSH 智能体与子智能体谁向谁汇报，叠加在固定的原生树之上。

description.en: Local ComfyUI workbench for DSH with queue and progress monitoring, prompt editing, image library, workflow canvas and agent tools.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的本地 ComfyUI 工作台，提供系统与队列状态、生成进度、提示词编辑、本地图片库、工作流画布和代理工具。

description.en: Local ComfyUI image plugin for DSH: one generate_image tool covering text-to-image, image-to-image, inpainting and background removal.
description.zh: DSH 的本地 ComfyUI 图片生成插件：单个 generate_image 工具覆盖文生图、图生图、局部重绘和去背景。

description.en: Lets you control when DSH compacts your conversation, with per-provider and per-model settings to stop premature summarization.
description.zh: 让你按服务商和模型分别设置 DSH 何时压缩对话，避免过早被摘要。

description.en: Adds terminal-style input history, draft stashing, and Esc recovery to the DeepSeek Harness web composer.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页输入框添加终端式历史记录：方向键优先从行首边缘浏览、草稿暂存与精确恢复、Esc 找回。

description.en: Adds ordered and unordered list editing to the DSH composer with auto numbering, marker-aware caret moves and undoable AI prompt polish.
description.zh: 为 DSH 输入框添有序/无序列表编辑：自动编号、标记感知光标移动、空行编排及可撤销的 AI 提示词优化。

description.en: Diagnoses silent plugin conflicts in DeepSeek Harness and gives the exact patch that fixes each one.
description.zh: 诊断 DeepSeek Harness 中插件间的隐性冲突，并给出修复每个冲突的精确补丁。

description.en: DSH sidebar panel that shows SenseNova Token Plan credit usage in real time and can optionally register SenseNova models as a DSH provider.
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏面板，实时展示商汤 Token Plan 积分用量，并可选把商汤模型注册为 DSH provider。

description.en: Audits token cost of instruction chains, skill catalogs, and tool schemas; detects duplicates and conflicts; provides Web UI and context_audit tool.
description.zh: 审计 DSH 上下文注入的 token 成本，统计指令链、技能目录与工具 schema，检测重复和冲突，并提供 Web UI 圆环面板与 context_audit 工具。

description.en: Folds finished tool outputs and reasoning at phase boundaries into spill files, keeping only conclusions in the context window to cut token cost.
description.zh: 在阶段边界把已出结果、不再需要全文的工具输出与思考过程折叠起来，结论留在上下文窗口，原文落盘可随时取回，降低长会话的 token 成本。

description.en: OpenAI-compatible proxy and DeepSeek Harness engine that compacts context for local LLMs without breaking the session.
description.zh: 兼容 OpenAI 的代理与 DeepSeek Harness 引擎，为本地模型压缩上下文，触发可靠且不会中断会话。

description.en: DSH session cost billing plugin showing account balance, peak/off-peak pricing, and per-session spend breakdown in the input bar and sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 会话费用账单插件：展示账号余额、峰谷计价，以及每个会话（含子代理衍生会话）的消耗构成，输入框与侧栏双入口。

description.en: DSH plugin that manages CLIProxyAPI accounts (balance, check-in, switching) and auto-registers four channels of chat models, starting/stopping with DSH.
description.zh: DSH 插件：管理 CLIProxyAPI 账号（余额、签到、切换），自动注册四个渠道的对话模型，并随 DSH 启停。

description.en: Portable AI image-retouching and video-editing skill pack for DeepSeek Harness, covering matting, inpainting, compositing, batch exports and timeline editing.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的便携式 AI 图像修图与视频剪辑技能包，涵盖抠图、修复、合成、批量导出与时间线剪辑。

description.en: Sidebar console for managing self-hosted cron-task panels (Qinglong 2.x and Daidai 3.x): connections, environment variables and scheduled jobs.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏管理自托管定时任务面板（青龙 2.x 与呆呆 3.x）的控制台：面板连接、环境变量与定时任务。

description.en: Adds a custom CSS editor under Settings → General → Appearance in the DSH Web GUI, with DevTools-style completion, validation and rule panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH Web GUI 的设置 → 通用 → 外观下方增加自定义 CSS 编辑器，具备补全、校验与规则面板等 DevTools 风格体验。

description.en: Sealed DSH persona plugin with tiered growing memory, chat/work modes, nightly dream-journal consolidation and SiYuan sync plus local backup.
description.zh: 昔涟 sealed 人设插件：分层成长记忆、聊天与工作双模式、每日夜梦整理，并支持思源同步与本地备份。

description.en: Pink-and-white frosted-glass Cyrene theme for the DSH Web GUI, with editable agent persona, reaction stickers and rotating full-page backgrounds.
description.zh: 《崩坏：星穹铁道》昔涟主题：粉白毛玻璃皮肤，支持侧边栏改人格、表情包回复与整页背景轮换。

description.en: Local-first AI livestream console that runs characters, answers Douyin chat and gifts, and governs memory, skills and training.
description.zh: 本地优先的 AI 直播控制台：管理角色、接收抖音互动并生成播出回复，同时治理记忆、技能与训练。

description.en: Deterministic data profiling, cleaning, and verification for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的数据剖析、清洗与校验功能。

description.en: Web-managed database plugin that lets the Agent run authorized read-only queries on MySQL, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB.
description.zh: 通过 Web 管理连接的数据库插件，让 Agent 在授权下执行只读查询，支持 MySQL、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB。

description.en: A dreamy pink fish desktop pet for the DSH Web UI that shows all live sessions at a glance and lets you approve requests in place.
description.zh: 一只梦幻粉色小鱼桌宠，作为 DSH Web UI 的虚拟形象入口，同屏展示多会话状态并就地完成审批。

description.en: Get local alerts and a task inbox when DeepSeek Harness tasks require human attention.
description.zh: 当DeepSeek Harness任务需要人工介入时，提供本地提醒与任务收件箱。

description.en: Evidence-first deep reading for AI agents to trace claims, evidence, confidence and knowledge maps from documents.
description.zh: 为 AI 代理提供以证据为先的深度阅读，从文章、书籍和 PDF 中追踪论点、证据与置信度并构建知识图谱。

description.en: Adds a CHAT/HARNESS toggle to DSH desktop, embedding the real DeepSeek Chat website beside the native workspace.
description.zh: 为 DSH 桌面版提供 CHAT/HARNESS 一键切换，在原生工作区旁嵌入真实的 DeepSeek 官网聊天。

description.en: DeepTutor bridge for dsh providing learning capabilities, knowledge bases, and note archiving tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 DeepTutor 桥接，接入学习能力、知识库与笔记归档工具。

description.en: A git history graph and operations panel for the dsh web IDE, ported from vscode-git-graph.
description.zh: 为dsh Web IDE提供的Git历史图与操作面板，移植自vscode-git-graph。

description.en: Developer utilities plugin for DeepSeek Harness with pinable sidebar tabs and built-in agent tools.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供开发者工具，包含可固定的侧边栏标签页与内置 agent 工具。

description.en: Spec-driven service factory and local agent workbench for DSH, with standards vault, service generation, and a web ops console.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的规范驱动服务工厂与本地智能体工作台，提供标准库、服务生成和运维面板。

description.en: Third-party workflow library for DSH that lets you review, save, parameterize and reuse successful task workflows.
description.zh: DSH 的第三方工作流库，可回顾、保存、参数化并复用成功的任务工作流。

description.en: DSH plugin that injects a docs convention, scaffolds a dsh docs/ directory, and validates document structure and links.
