description.zh: DSH 插件：注入文档规范，生成 dsh docs/ 文档骨架，并校验文档结构与相对链接。

description.en: Provides deterministic diagnostics and recovery for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供确定性的诊断与恢复功能

description.en: Doubao desktop pet in the Web UI corner showing cost/quota bubbles, draggable and resizable, plus Doubao image generation via agent tools and Ark API.
description.zh: Web 界面角落的豆包桌宠，悬浮显示资费与额度气泡，可拖动缩放贴边，并通过 Agent 工具与方舟 API 生图。

description.en: Adds a single download tool for DeepSeek Harness that auto-picks Motrix, direct, yt-dlp or Hugging Face as the engine and blocks stray curl -o writes.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一下载工具，按目标自动选择 Motrix、直连、yt-dlp 或 Hugging Face 引擎，并拦截 curl -o 私自写盘。

description.en: Persists unsent DSH composer drafts on the Host instead of browser localStorage, surviving reloads, session switches and Host restarts across devices.
description.zh: 将未发送的 DSH 输入框草稿保存在 Host 而非浏览器 localStorage，可跨刷新、切会话、Host 重启及多设备保留。

description.en: Unified image-generation router with config-driven engine routing, fallback, attachments, quotas, and settings panel.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供统一的 image_generate 图像生成工具，可按配置路由到 OpenAI Images、智谱 CogView 等兼容接口，支持故障自动回退、会话配额统计、附件持久化保存及插件设置面板。

description.en: Validates an emergency drill script for completeness and arithmetic, checking phases, commander, response level, resources, durations and step numbering.
description.zh: 校验应急演练脚本的完整性与算术：演练阶段、指挥员、响应等级、资源、时长合计与步骤编号。

description.en: DSH plugin that displays your DeepSeek account balance at the bottom of the left sidebar using native UI.
description.zh: DSH 插件，在左侧边栏底部以原生界面显示你的 DeepSeek 账户余额。

description.en: DSH plugin that joins multiple machines into one fleet so you can dispatch work to any, some, or all of them in natural language.
description.zh: DSH 插件：把多台机器接入同一鸭群，用自然语言给「某个/某几个/全部」机器派活。

description.en: A novelty "dumb mode" that rewrites the assistant's thinking and replies into short refusals and rejects every tool call.
description.zh: 装傻模式：把助手的思考与回答改写成『我不懂啊』『我不帮你做』等短句，并拒绝所有工具调用。

description.en: DSH plugin that compresses conversation context in layers (L0→L1→L2→L3), keeping older content at coarser resolution but never deleting it.
description.zh: DSH 分层上下文压缩插件：原文按 L1→L2→L3 逐层降分辨率，越旧越粗但从不删除。

description.en: Headlessly generates KiCad/TSCircuit schematics and PCBs, auto-validates designs, and exports Gerber and STEP files in one click.
description.zh: 使用KiCad和TSCircuit无头绘制原理图与PCB，自动完成校验，并一键导出Gerber和STEP文件。

description.en: DSH plugin that connects the agent to EasyEDA Pro via local MCP tools so it can draw and edit schematics.
description.zh: 通过本地 MCP 与 WebSocket 桥接，将 DSH 连接到嘉立创EDA专业版 / EasyEDA Pro，让智能体调用工具绘制原理图。

description.en: Anime desktop-pet companion for DeepSeek Harness, adapting the edgerunners characters Roman, Talia, Di and Wick as decorative on-screen personas.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供的动漫桌宠伴侣，将 edgerunners 角色 Roman、Talia、Di 和 Wick 作为装饰性形象呈现。

description.en: Local BM25 auto-recall, write guard, static doctor, and memory panel for an Engramory markdown store, with no network or daemon.
description.zh: 为 Engramory Markdown 存储提供本地 BM25 自动召回、写入保护、静态诊断和记忆面板，无需网络或守护进程。

description.en: Reads each conversation turn as E/S/P emotion curves, classifies state shapes and remembers them under names you choose yourself.
description.zh: 把每轮对话读成 E/S/P 三条情绪曲线，先分状态形状，再按你自己起的名字归类并记忆。

description.en: Host-side DSH control plugin that injects per-trial aeval config, caps budget, and seals evidence into a verifiable bundle descriptor.
description.zh: 宿主侧 DSH 评测控制插件：为 aeval 单次试次注入配置、封顶预算，并密封可校验的证据包。

description.en: Registers a 'search files' model tool in DSH that finds file names and paths on Windows via the Everything es.exe CLI.
description.zh: 为 DSH 注册 search files 模型工具，在 Windows 上通过 Everything 的 es.exe 命令行快速搜索文件名与路径。

description.en: Hash-chained, append-only evidence ledger from dsh-super-agent that records agent activity inside DeepSeek Harness and makes tampering detectable.
description.zh: 来自 dsh-super-agent 的哈希链式只追加证据账本，在 DeepSeek Harness 中记录并防篡改校验。

description.en: Standalone DSH bundle adding self-evolution to dsh, with inspect→propose→trial→measure→revert workflows, canary promotion and rollback.
description.zh: 独立 DSH bundle，为 dsh 提供自我进化能力：inspect→propose→trial→measure→revert 流程、canary 晋升与回滚。

description.en: Expert roster plugin for DeepSeek Harness: 623 experts in 22 categories, summonable as sub-agents via @ menu or model tools.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 专家名册插件：22 个分类、623 位专家，可通过 @ 菜单或模型工具召唤为子代理。

description.en: Agent preset that plans PM-first, delegates tasks to expert subagents, enforces gated delivery, and pools experience across runs.
description.zh: 专家编排模式预设：PM 先规划，委派专家子代理执行，交付门控并沉淀经验池。

description.en: Batch export selected Sessions as restorable ZIP archives with logs, subagent sessions and attachments, then restore them on another machine along with plugin inventory.
description.zh: 批量导出所选会话为可恢复的 ZIP 归档（日志、子代理会话与附件），并可在另一台机器上恢复，同时迁移插件清单。

description.en: Reads an export control item register and cross-checks the register's own completeness and licence closure, item by item.
description.zh: 读取出出口管制物项登记表，逐项交叉检查登记表自身的完整性与许可证闭环情况。

description.en: Read-only performance diagnostics for DeepSeek Harness sessions: load timing, spill hits, compaction, context-injection volume, and LLM cache hit rate via /fast command and fast_report tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 会话提供只读性能诊断，通过 /fast 命令和 fast_report 工具查看会话加载耗时、spill 命中次数、压缩次数与触发原因、上下文注入量及 LLM 缓存命中率。

description.en: Windows DSH plugin that connects Feishu Doubao Work enterprise models with account management and usage history tracking.
description.zh: Windows DSH 插件，接入飞书豆包企业版模型，支持账号管理与使用历史记录。

description.en: DSH plugin connecting a XiaoZhi ESP32-S3 voice terminal to a multi-platform AI companion with GPT-SoVITS voice cloning and ASR/TTS.
description.zh: DSH 插件：连接小智 ESP32-S3 语音终端，提供 B站/QQ/微信/抖音多平台 AI 陪伴角色，并支持 GPT-SoVITS 语音克隆与火山引擎 ASR/TTS。

description.en: One-click Figma MCP connector for DSH that handles OAuth authorization, token status display, silent refresh and local disconnect.
description.zh: DSH 的 Figma MCP 一键连接插件，负责 OAuth 授权、token 状态显示、静默刷新与本地断开。

description.en: Searchable library that keeps every file sent to DeepSeek Harness, with one-click filing and @library reuse.
description.zh: 可搜索的文件库，保存所有发送到 DeepSeek Harness 的文件，支持一键归档和 @library 复用。

description.en: Review files changed by an agent, showing diffs within DeepSeek Harness Web.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中查看 agent 刚修改过的文件的差异对比，方便逐个审查改动内容。

description.en: Adds a WeChat-style group chat view where the user and several DSH sessions talk and discuss together in one shared room.
description.zh: 添加一个微信群风格的群聊视图，让用户与多个 DSH 会话在同一个房间里同时聊天、讨论。

description.en: Core quick-control panel for the DSH web UI: floating/docked panel, extensible switch registry, skin system, zh/en i18n and alert surfaces.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的快捷控制面板核心：悬浮/停靠面板、可扩展开关注册表、皮肤系统、中英文 i18n 与提示浮层。

description.en: Unofficial DSH agent preset plus a Windows beta test bundle for FoloToy AI Passport projects.
description.zh: 面向 FoloToy AI Passport 项目的非官方 DSH 智能体预设与 Windows 测试打包组件。

description.en: DSH host guardrail that blocks any foreground tool call likely to block for more than 60 seconds, with a once-per-turn manual override.
description.zh: DSH 前台守卫插件：拦截可能阻塞前台超过 60 秒的工具调用，每回合可手动授权一次。

description.en: Vision bridge plugin for dsh adding image understanding to text-only models via luma-mcp, using free Qwen3-VL-Flash by default.
description.zh: 为 dsh 纯文本模型通过 luma-mcp 接入图像理解能力，默认使用免费的 Qwen3-VL-Flash 模型。

description.en: DSH provider route that auto-selects the best free LLM through a local FreeLLMAPI gateway, with automatic failover and native chunk streaming.
description.zh: DSH 提供商路由，通过本地 FreeLLMAPI 网关自动选择最佳免费模型，支持自动故障转移并以原生分块流式返回。

description.en: A DSH skill plugin that turns building a web page into a four-step engineering flow (requirement, design, implementation, acceptance) with a 32-rule frontend spec checker and 68-entry component librar
description.zh: 一个把页面开发变成需求、设计、实现、验收四步流程的 DSH 技能插件，内置 32 条前端规范红线检查器和 68 个组件库选型目录。

description.en: Adds encoding-adaptive file access to dsh: UTF-8/UTF-8 BOM passthrough, byte-exact round-trips for 16 legacy encodings, and encoding-aware grep.
description.zh: 为 dsh 提供编码自适应文件访问：UTF-8/UTF-8 BOM 直通、16 种传统编码的字节级精确往返，以及感知编码的 grep。

description.en: One-click Windows installer that adds a Fujiang persona preset and 240 bundled skills to DeepSeek Harness Desktop, changing only DSH_HOME.
description.zh: Windows 一键安装器，为 DeepSeek Harness Desktop 添加富江人格预设与 240 个随包技能，只修改 DSH_HOME。

description.en: Desktop sidebar plugin for DeepSeek Harness to quickly view ongoing gacha banners and event dates for 11 mobile games, with auto-refresh.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness桌面端侧边栏插件，快速查看11款主流二游当期卡池与活动时间，支持联网自动刷新。

description.en: Turns one character sheet into game-ready assets using Seedream image gen, MiniMax image-to-video, and local ffmpeg processing.
description.zh: 从一张角色设定图出发，用 Seedream 生图、MiniMax 图生视频，配合本机 ffmpeg 批量生成游戏素材。

description.en: Integrates Gemini 4 Argon on Google Vertex AI into DeepSeek Harness with streaming, tool calls, and thought-signature replay.
description.zh: 将 Google Vertex AI 上的 Gemini 4 Argon 集成到 DeepSeek Harness，支持流式输出、工具调用和思考签名回放。

description.en: Ghidra bridge for DSH exposing 218 reverse-engineering tools with a single-JVM unified mode and in-tree Ghidra install.
description.zh: DSH 的 Ghidra 桥接插件，提供 218 个逆向工程工具，支持单 JVM 统一模式与内置 Ghidra 安装。

description.en: Git automation plugin for DSH: scan repos, audit code, and one-click commit/push via tool or HTTP API.
description.zh: DSH 的 Git 自动化插件，可扫描仓库，并通过工具或 HTTP API 一键执行 commit 和 push。

description.en: Windows DSH plugin that routes the bash tool through Git Bash and removes PowerShell from every agent's toolset.
description.zh: Windows 上的 DSH 插件，将 bash 工具交由 Git Bash 执行，并从所有 agent 中移除 PowerShell。

description.en: Integrates GitHub CLI into DSH for PR, Issue, Actions CI diagnostics and code review, exposed via agent tools, slash commands and Web UI.
description.zh: 基于 GitHub CLI 为 DSH 提供 PR、Issue、Actions CI 诊断与代码审查工作流，支持 Agent 工具、Slash 指令与 Web UI。

description.en: Edit ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md global rules from DeepSeek Harness web settings panel with live saving.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则并实时保存。

description.en: A shared global todo list kept in one JSON file that both a person and an AI agent can read and write.
description.zh: 一个以单个 JSON 文件保存的全局待办清单，人类和 AI 智能体都能读写。

description.en: Graph-based goal management plugin for DSH that organizes work into goal boards with a full lifecycle.
description.zh: 基于图的 DSH 目标管理插件，把工作组织成目标看板并覆盖完整生命周期。

description.en: Publishes and updates GreasyFork userscripts: read versions, push new releases with changelogs, edit descriptions, search the site and check your account.
description.zh: 将用户脚本发布/更新到 GreasyFork：读取版本、带更新日志推送新版本、改简介、站内搜索与账号凭证管理。

description.en: Grok plugin for DeepSeek Harness with OAuth login, fused web/X search, and Imagine image generation.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Grok 插件，支持 OAuth 登录，可在主循环中融合网页与 X 搜索，并调用 Imagine 生成图像。

description.en: Adds a visual Grok-powered web search to DeepSeek Harness with automatic fallback to Tavily, Exa, TinyFish and Firecrawl.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入可视化 Grok 主搜索，并在失败时自动回退到 Tavily、Exa、TinyFish 和 Firecrawl。

description.en: Adds aggregate status badges to collapsed sidebar group rows in DSH, showing running, pending-approval and scheduled sessions.
description.zh: 为 DSH 侧栏收起的分组行添加聚合状态徽标，显示进行中、待审批与定时任务数量。

description.en: Checks a HAZOP worksheet for required-field completeness, node/guide-word validity, risk vocabulary, and deviation traceability.
description.zh: 检查 HAZOP 工作表的字段完整性、节点与引导词合规性、风险等级词表及偏差可追溯性。

description.en: Edit earlier user messages in the chat history and regenerate the reply within the same DeepSeek Harness session.
description.zh: 在同一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话中编辑历史用户消息并重新生成回复。

description.en: Adds a fixed in-window button to hot-restart DeepSeek Harness with no console windows, plus a self-check that writes a diagnostic report.
description.zh: 在窗口内提供固定按钮，一键零控制台热重启 DeepSeek Harness，并内置自检生成单文件诊断报告。

description.en: Enhances dsh-im by giving every AI agent a home, showing which workspace has agents online, and enabling drag-and-drop relocation.
description.zh: 通过助理和家的概念增强 dsh-im，一览各工作区助理状态并支持拖拽搬家。

description.en: Adds AVIF, TIFF and SVG support to DSH read_image and the composer by automatically converting them to PNG.
description.zh: 为 DSH 的 read_image 和输入框增加 AVIF、TIFF、SVG 支持，自动转换为 PNG。

description.en: Enables non-vision DeepSeek models to process chat images via built-in image recognition tool.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供插件，让 deepseek-v4-flash 等不支持视觉的模型通过内置识图工具处理聊天中的图片。

description.en: Two-step image studio: import a style reference, describe the scene, then generate structured JSON prompts and dual-model images in a workbench panel.
description.zh: 两步生图工作台：导入风格参考图并描述画面，即可生成结构化 JSON 提示词并用双模型出图。

description.en: One-click ✦ button rewrites your draft prompt into an agent-ready one, replacing it in place with undo support.
description.zh: 输入框一键 ✦ 按钮把草稿改写成 Agent 可执行的提示词，直接替换并支持一键撤回。

description.en: Injects custom model context and rewrites requests in DeepSeek Harness, with native Keysmith rules compatibility.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注入自定义模型上下文并重写请求，原生兼容 Keysmith 规则。

description.en: Adds a live headless Chrome/Edge browser panel in the dsh right sidebar that both the human and the agent can control.
description.zh: 在 dsh 右侧边栏加入一个由真实无头 Chrome/Edge 驱动的实时浏览器面板，人和智能体可同时操作。
